title: Kapampangan Curriculum Specialist / Kapampangan Coach
description:
Tahanan (
) is a language-learning app that teaches Tagalog and Bisaya to learners around the world through bite-sized lessons, flashcards, AI speaking practice, and feedback from real coaches. We're launching Kapampangan next, and we're looking for a native Kapampangan speaker to help us build it.



What you'll do

- Translate our full Tagalog curriculum (lessons, example sentences, vocabulary, and flashcards) into natural, everyday Kapampangan.

- Work in Google Docs. Each lesson comes prepared with the Tagalog source and an empty Kapampangan column, so you can focus on translating, not formatting.

- Flag words or phrases that don't translate directly and suggest how a native speaker would actually say them.

- Keep a short glossary so terms stay consistent across lessons.



What we're looking for

- Native or near-native Kapampangan speaker, fluent in Tagalog/Filipino and comfortable in English.

- Translation, localization, or proofreading experience.

- Careful with spelling, consistency, and tone. Learners will study every word you write.

- Reliable, full time, and able to share progress daily.



Optional (paid separately, tell us if you're interested)

- Voice recording: record Kapampangan words and sentences for pronunciation audio.

- Coaching after launch: give learners written or voice feedback on their Kapampangan recordings, paid per feedback.



Pay

- $3/hour, full time, paid monthly.

- Long-term work: after the translation, there's ongoing work in recording, review, and coaching as Kapampangan grows.



How to apply

Send a short message in Kapampangan and English introducing yourself, plus this sentence translated into Kapampangan: "Good morning! Have you eaten yet? Let's study together today."

title: After-Hours & Weekend On-Call Virtual Assistant
description:
Position: After-Hours & Weekend Scheduling and Customer Support VA

Pay Rate: $3.50–$4.00 USD per hour

Estimated Hours: 80–90 paid hours per week, depending on final scheduling arrangements

Work Location: Remote / Work From Home

Schedule: Evenings, Overnight, and Weekends

Industry: Home Care Services

About the Position

We are looking for a dependable, personable, and resourceful Virtual Assistant to provide after-hours and weekend phone support for a U.S.-based home care company.



This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants consistent paid hours but does not necessarily want to be actively working at a computer throughout their entire shift.



This is primarily an on-call position. You will be paid for your scheduled hours, even when call volume is low. Some shifts may have very few calls or no calls at all, while others may require you to actively troubleshoot scheduling issues, coordinate caregiver coverage, and assist clients.



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys helping people, communicates clearly, stays calm under pressure, and can independently solve problems as they arise.



This position could be a great fit for a stay-at-home parent or someone who prefers working from home with flexibility during quieter periods, provided they can remain consistently available and respond promptly whenever a call comes in.

Key Responsibilities



Answer incoming after-hours and weekend calls professionally, warmly, and promptly.

Assist clients, caregivers, and team members with scheduling questions, call-outs, and urgent concerns.

Coordinate caregiver replacements and shift coverage when employees call out or scheduling conflicts arise.

Troubleshoot scheduling challenges independently and follow established procedures to resolve issues.

Use scheduling and communication platforms to document calls, update information, and coordinate coverage.

Escalate urgent or sensitive situations to management when necessary.

Maintain accurate notes and communicate important updates to the daytime team.

Remain accessible and responsive throughout all assigned on-call hours, even during periods of low call volume.

Required Skills & Qualifications



Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and a calm, easy-to-understand speaking pace. Our clients need someone who speaks clearly and does not rush through conversations.

Strong customer service skills with a friendly, patient, and professional phone presence.

Ability to remain calm and make good decisions during stressful or time-sensitive situations.

Strong independent problem-solving skills. We need someone who can think critically, take initiative, and work through challenges without constant supervision.

Excellent reliability and responsiveness during scheduled hours.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Comfortable working with multiple software platforms and learning new systems.

Previous experience with scheduling, dispatching, customer support, or coordinating employee coverage is preferred.

Preferred Software Experience

Experience with the following platforms is a plus:



AxisCare – Home care scheduling and caregiver management

Quo (formerly OpenPhone) – Business phone and communication platform

Microsoft Excel – Tracking, documentation, and data management

Prior experience with home care agencies, healthcare scheduling, dispatching, or after-hours answering services is highly desirable.

Schedule & Availability

Coverage is needed during the following U.S. hours:



Monday–Friday: 5:00 PM–8:00 AM

Saturday–Sunday: 24-hour coverage

We anticipate approximately 80–90 paid hours per week for this position, depending on how coverage is divided between team members.



Our preference is to find one highly dependable individual who can cover a substantial portion of these hours, although we may consider splitting the schedule between multiple VAs.

Important: Understanding the On-Call Nature of This Role

This is not a traditional position where you will be actively completing tasks every minute of your shift.



Some days or nights, you may receive no calls.

Other times, a single caregiver call-out could result in 1–2 hours of active scheduling and problem-solving.

You will still be paid for your scheduled on-call hours, even during quiet periods.

You are not expected to sit in front of your computer continuously when there are no calls, but you must remain reachable and ready to respond.

You must have a quiet environment available for professional phone conversations and be able to access your computer promptly when scheduling work is required.

You must be able to manage your personal responsibilities without interfering with your ability to answer calls and handle urgent situations.

Reliability is absolutely essential. The client and caregivers depend on this position for support outside normal business hours.



Compensation

$3.50–$4.00 USD per hour, based on experience and qualifications.



While the hourly rate is lower than some traditional VA positions, this role offers the opportunity for a high number of paid hours with potentially significant periods of downtime between calls.



All scheduled on-call hours are paid, regardless of call volume.

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

You may be an excellent candidate if you:



Are a stay-at-home parent or someone looking for a home-based opportunity with flexible downtime.

Enjoy talking to people and genuinely care about providing excellent customer service.

Are comfortable handling unpredictable call volume and occasional stressful situations.

Can remain available and dependable during evening, overnight, and weekend hours.

Are a natural problem-solver who doesn’t need someone telling you what to do every step of the way.

Have experience scheduling employees, managing call-outs, dispatching, or coordinating shifts.

Want consistent paid hours in a role where the amount of active work may vary significantly.

title: Vectorworks Draftsperson for German Architecture Projects (construction drawings, remote, ongoing)
description:
We are a German drafting service and we are looking for a Vectorworks draftsperson to produce construction drawings to German standards, on an ongoing basis.



This is not a one-off gig. We want to build a working relationship with one or two reliable Vectorworks people and send every suitable Vectorworks job their way as our order volume grows.



What we do



We prepare drawings for architects, building companies and private clients in Germany. We handle the client, the files and the full specification. Some of our clients are architects who work in Vectorworks themselves and need the project as a Vectorworks file they can continue working in, built in their own office template. That is what this post is about.



A typical job: interior fit-out of an existing office building for a new tenant. A demolition plan and a new construction plan at 1:50, laid out per building section, in the architect's Vectorworks template.



The way we work is different from most drafting jobs. The thinking and checking is done on our side. Before you start, we prepare a clean DXF/DWG base:

- the existing building on its own layers, with everything to be demolished marked

- every new wall drawn as lines, on one layer per wall type

- every door as a marker with door number, width and swing

- a room list with room numbers and names

- dimension chains and one sheet frame per building section



Your job is to build this cleanly in Vectorworks, inside the architect's template:

- walls with the client's wall styles, joined correctly

- doors as door objects in the client's door style, at our markers

- space objects with room number and name as room stamps

- the client's classes and design layers, not your own

- sheet layers with viewports at 1:50, the client's title block and legend

- export of vector PDF and DWG, and the .vwx saved in the Vectorworks version we name for the project



What you need



1. Your own commercial Vectorworks license: Vectorworks Architect or Design Suite, version 2026 or newer. This is a must. No educational version (educational files and prints are watermarked, which would damage our client's drawings), no trial version, and no license that belongs to an employer or another client. If we shortlist you, we will ask for a screenshot of your license information.



2. Real experience with construction documents in Vectorworks: wall styles, door objects, space objects, classes and design layers, sheet layers, viewports and title blocks. Renderings, event or landscape drawings alone are not enough.



3. Comfortable working inside someone else's template. Our clients' offices have their own classes, styles and title blocks, and the drawing has to look as if it came from their own office.



4. Work entirely in metric. Metres and centimetres. If your drafting experience is in feet and inches, this job is not for you.



5. Work to German drawing conventions. Most of them come with the client's template, and we specify the rest in a written brief in English, for example:

- Dimension lines with a 45° oblique tick, never an arrowhead

- Comma as decimal separator: 3,99, never 3.99

- Dimensions of one metre and more in metres with two decimals, smaller ones in centimetres; half centimetres as a small raised 5

- Openings dimensioned with the width above the dimension line and the height below it

- Differentiated pen weights; a drawing where every line has the same weight is not acceptable

- Text in a font that renders German characters (ä ö ü ß) correctly

You do not need to know these by heart. But you need to be the kind of drafter who follows a specification to the millimetre.



6. Communicate in written English. You do not need to speak German. All German text on the drawing (room names, notes, title block) is supplied as ready-to-copy strings.



7. Keep client files confidential. You sign a confidentiality agreement before you see any client files.



What you get from us



We do not send vague requests. Before you start a job you receive the prepared DXF/DWG base described above, the client's template, the written brief and a reference PDF of how the finished sheets should look. There are no design decisions for you to make and nothing to guess. If something in our package is ambiguous, you ask and we answer. That is on us, not on you.



Pay



USD 8 – 15 per hour, depending on the quality, speed and experience you show. Paid by the hour for the time you actually work, and paid on time.



How we start



The first assignment is a small paid test task of about two hours, with our own test data, no client data: we send you a small DXF base of part of an office floor and the specification of two wall styles. You build the walls, six doors and the room stamps, set up one sheet at 1:50 with a viewport and a title block, and deliver .vwx (saved as Vectorworks 2026), PDF and DWG. Paid at your agreed rate. It tells both of us within a day whether it works out.



On volume, honestly: we are a young business and growing. We have a concrete Vectorworks enquiry on our desk right now, but Vectorworks jobs come in less often than our AutoCAD work. We are not going to promise you a guaranteed number of hours every week, because we cannot. What we can say is that we intend to send every suitable Vectorworks job to the same person.



Please do NOT apply if

- You do not have your own commercial license of Vectorworks Architect or Design Suite

- You have used Vectorworks only for renderings, stage/event or landscape drawings

- You work primarily in feet and inches

- You cannot show sheets you have drawn yourself in Vectorworks

- You need a guaranteed full-time workload right now



A straight "this is not my kind of work" costs you nothing and we will remember you positively.



HOW TO APPLY - please read, this d
 it



1. Start your message with the word WANDSTIL. It is German for "wall style". It tells us you read the post rather than mass-applying. Applications without it are not read.



2. Attach one or two PDFs of construction drawings you have drawn yourself in Vectorworks, exported from a sheet layer: a dimensioned floor plan with room stamps and a title block. Add one screenshot from Vectorworks of the same project with a wall selected and the Object Info palette visible. This is by far the most important part of your application.



We will look at exactly these things in your sample:

- Is it a real working drawing: dimensions, room stamps, title block, legend?

- Are the pen weights differentiated?

- Is it in metric?

- Are the walls real wall objects with a wall style, or just lines?



3. Answer these five questions, briefly:



a) Which Vectorworks product and version do you use (Architect, Design Suite, Fundamentals, Landmark, Spotlight), and is the license a commercial license in your own name? Which other CAD software do you own? Tell us the actual versions.



b) We send you a DWG in which the new walls are lines, on one layer per wall type, and the doors are block markers. In two or three sentences: how do you turn this into Vectorworks walls with the client's wall styles, how do you place the doors, and how do you create the room stamps?



c) Which countries' standards have you drawn to? If you have worked on German, Austrian, Swiss or other European projects, say so and say which office or client. That moves you to the front of the queue.



d) What is your hourly rate for this work, and roughly how many hours would you estimate for one office floor of about 2,000 m² with about 70 rooms and 80 doors, starting from our prepared base: walls, doors, room stamps, dimensions and about 12 sheets at 1:50 in the client's template?



e) When can you work? Please list every day from Monday to Sunday with the hours you are usually available, in Philippine time, for example:

Monday: 9:00 – 17:00 (8 hours)

Tuesday: 18:00 – 22:00 (4 hours)

Sunday: not available

Also tell us how quickly you usually reply to messages on those days.



4. Tell us how fast you could start once a project comes in, and whether you could start within the next seven days.



Thank you for reading this far. We know it is a long post, and that is deliberate. We would rather have five applications from people who fit than fifty from people who do not.



Sander Marquardt

Zeichenpartner, Germany

title: Real Estate Quality Control and Media Delivery Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-time remote position

Hours: 40 hours per week

Workdays: Tuesday through Saturday (Saturday availability is required)

Compensation: Approximately $800 USD per month

Required Language: Strong written English



Working Hours

- This position supports a U.S. Eastern Time (ET) schedule.

- You must have sufficient availability during Eastern Time mornings to support timely media reviews and morning deliveries.

- Daily start and end times are flexible and will be coordinated with the client.

- You must be available consistently from Tuesday through Saturday.

- Saturday availability is mandatory and cannot be negotiated.



Please apply only if you can consistently commit to 40 hours per week, including Saturdays, and coordinate your schedule with U.S. Eastern Time.



About the Role



Bold City Virtual Tours is looking for a highly dependable, detail-oriented, and proactive Virtual Assistant to handle quality control and media delivery for real estate photography and marketing projects.



Your primary responsibility will be to review completed property media, identify errors or inconsistencies, organize project files, and ensure that all deliverables are accurate, complete, and ready to be sent to clients on time.



This is not an experience-first position. Previous professional quality control or real estate media experience is not required. We are looking for someone with excellent attention to detail, strong accountability, a willingness to learn, and the ability to take ownership of daily responsibilities.



We need someone who doesn't simply check files and move on, but takes responsibility for making sure every project is properly reviewed and delivered.



Key Responsibilities

- Review completed real estate photography, videos, drone imagery, 3D tours, and other property media

- Perform quality control checks to identify visual inconsistencies and editing mistakes

- Check photos for crooked vertical lines, inconsistent colors, exposure issues, and other quality concerns

- Identify missing images, incorrect files, and incomplete deliverables

- Ensure all required media is present before a project is marked complete

- Organize property files and maintain accurate project records

- Follow established quality control and media delivery workflows

- Ensure completed projects are reviewed and delivered promptly, especially during morning ET delivery periods

- Clearly communicate quality issues, missing files, and outstanding corrections

- Coordinate with Trey and the team regarding project updates and delivery concerns

- Manage daily responsibilities independently after training

- Proactively identify recurring problems and suggest improvements to the quality control and delivery process



Required Qualifications

- Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly and professionally

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Highly reliable, consistent, and accountable

- Able to commit to a full-time, 40-hour workweek

- Available Tuesday through Saturday, including every Saturday

- Able to coordinate sufficient working hours with U.S. Eastern Time mornings

- Organized and capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines

- Comfortable working independently without constant supervision

- Proactive in identifying problems and following through until they are resolved

- Willing to accept feedback, learn new workflows, and improve continuously

- Adaptable when priorities or workloads change

- Interested in a stable, long-term working relationship



Preferred Experience



Previous experience is helpful but not required. Experience in any of the following is an advantage:

- Quality control or quality assurance

- Real estate photography or videography

title: Senior Paid Media Analyst (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Senior Paid Media Analyst to independently own the strategy, execution, and performance of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across assigned client accounts.



This is not a “follow the platform recommendations” role. We need an analytical, proactive problem-solver who knows how to scale e-commerce campaigns profitably, spots growth opportunities without being asked, and takes real ownership of client results.



What You’ll Do



CAMPAIGN AND STRATEGY MANAGEMENT

Build, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns from scratch

Develop paid media strategies tied to client goals: e-commerce revenue, profitability, and lead generation

Manage budgets, pacing, bidding, targeting, and spend allocation

Run keyword research, search term analysis, and audience development

Manage Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta prospecting, remarketing, and catalog campaigns

Test campaign structures, bidding, audiences, creative, and new platform features

Troubleshoot performance drops, conversion tracking discrepancies, and delivery issues

Collaborate with internal teams on creative direction, promotions, and client initiatives



E-COMMERCE GROWTH

Build strategies that grow online sales, revenue, and profitable customer acquisition

Analyze ROAS, revenue, conversion rate, AOV, and CAC

Scale winning campaigns through budget allocation, audience expansion, product segmentation, and creative testing

Evaluate product-level performance across Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta catalog campaigns

Make recommendations based on revenue and profitability, not traffic or engagement



REPORTING AND CLIENT COMMUNICATIONS

Monitor CPA, ROAS, CPC, CTR, CVR, conversions, revenue, and AOV

Diagnose trends and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations

Maintain accurate campaign reporting

Join monthly or quarterly client calls and confidently present results, challenges, and strategy



REQUIREMENTS

3+ years of hands-on paid media experience, including building and launching campaigns from scratch

Experience managing individual client accounts with at least $10,000 in monthly ad spend per account (not combined spend across clients)

Proven e-commerce advertising experience with a track record of scaling revenue and ROAS

Strong proficiency in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager

Hands-on experience with Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta conversion campaigns

Solid grasp of campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience targeting, keyword management, and budget optimization

Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution

Familiarity with Google Merchant Center and product feeds

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

Ability to manage multiple accounts, budgets, and deadlines at once

Clear, confident communication with clients and internal teams



Nice to Have

- Agency experience managing clients across different industries

- Experience with both e-commerce and lead generation campaigns

- Experience with Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Basis, GroundTruth, or other programmatic platforms

- Familiarity with TapClicks, Shopify, Meta Commerce Manager, product catalogs, and Klaviyo

- Experience building creative testing strategies and giving performance-based creative recommendations



Send the following:

1. Your resume - make sure it's a shareable link

2. Portfolio which includes the largest single account you’ve managed: industry, monthly ad spend, and one result you’re proud of (e.g., ROAS or revenue growth)

3. The platforms you’ve built campaigns on from scratch



Applications missing these details will not be considered and only qualified applicants will be contacted. 

Thank you and good luck!

title: Operations Trainer
description:
Role Summary



PawPay is a growing company focused on delivering innovative financial solutions for the veterinary industry. As our team continues to expand, we are looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist who can take ownership of our employee training programs, learning materials, and professional development initiatives. We are looking for someone who is not only an experienced trainer but also a strong content creator, researcher, and LMS administrator who can independently develop engaging learning experiences.







Key Responsibilities



Training Material Development & Content Creation

Learning Management System (LMS) Administration

Training Facilitation & Employee Development

Research & Learning Program Improvement

Training Administration & Coordination

Others to follow



Qualifications



At least 2 years of professional experience as a Trainer, Training Specialist, Learning & Development Specialist, or similar role.

Hands-on experience creating training materials is mandatory, including presentations, instructional guides, e-learning modules, and assessments.

Practical experience using and administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is mandatory. Experience with TalentLMS, Moodle, Docebo, or similar platforms is acceptable.

Proven experience facilitating training sessions, preferably in a remote or virtual work environment.

Strong research skills, with the ability to independently gather, validate, and organize information into effective learning materials.

A creative eye for visual design, presentation layout, and engaging educational content.

Familiarity with training administration, including scheduling, attendance tracking, progress monitoring, reporting, and documentation.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Google Workspace, and other content creation tools.

Ability to work independently, proactively communicate updates, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Must be available to conduct training, onboarding, and coordination meetings during assigned PST working hours.





Preferred Candidate



We’re looking for someone who is:



Experience in BPO, SaaS, fintech, insurance, customer service, or other fast-paced industries.

Experience developing structured onboarding programs and employee certification pathways.

Familiarity with instructional design principles, such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, or adult learning methodologies.

Experience using AI-powered content creation and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gamma, or similar platforms.

Basic video editing, graphic design, or interactive course creation experience.

Experience conducting training needs analysis (TNA) and measuring training effectiveness.

Experience supporting leadership development, compliance training, and employee engagement initiatives.

What we're looking for: 



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the L&D function rather than simply facilitate training sessions.



Our ideal candidate is:



Creative: Can transform ordinary training content into engaging and visually appealing learning experiences.

Resourceful: Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics and independently developing learning materials.

Organized: Can manage training calendars, LMS assignments, attendance, deadlines, and reports without constant supervision.

Proactive: Regularly provides updates, identifies potential issues early, and follows through on commitments.

Confident Trainer: Comfortable conducting live virtual sessions and engaging employees with different experience levels.

Tech-Savvy: Familiar with digital learning platforms, collaboration tools, and AI-assisted content creation.

Dependable: Available during agreed working hours and responsive to training requests and team coordination.



If you’re someone who thrives in a results-oriented, entrepreneurial environment and wants to grow quickly, this is the right place for you.

title: Construction Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online & Job Costing Cleanup
description:
**Construction Bookkeeper — QuickBooks & Historical Project Cleanup**



**Remote | Philippines | Freelance/project-based**



We’re Bespoke Design + Build, a custom design-build company in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho. We’re hiring an experienced construction bookkeeper to organize historical project records, clean up project job costing, and align QuickBooks Online with our already-reconciled Uplinq records.



Some outstanding client balances are disputed. We need someone who can reconstruct each project’s financial history and clearly document what was charged, paid, credited, and remains outstanding. You should be comfortable investigating discrepancies, following supporting documents, and working independently with little oversight.



**QuickBooks Online proficiency is essential. Prior Houzz Pro or Uplinq experience is not required—we’ll help you learn both.**



**Responsibilities**



- Match QuickBooks bank and credit card transactions to existing bills, expenses, payments, and deposits without creating duplicates.

- Compare QuickBooks with reconciled Uplinq records, investigate differences, and document corrections.

- Clean up historical and active project costs in Houzz Pro, assigning expenses to the correct jobs and categories.

- Match subcontractor invoices, vendor bills, receipts, credits, and payments across systems.

- Identify missing costs, duplicate entries, incorrect allocations, unapplied payments, and incomplete documentation.

- Separate project costs from company overhead and actual expenses from estimates and purchase commitments.

- Review contracts, change orders, client invoices, payments, deposits, and credits to reconstruct project balances.

- Check billed markup and tax against documented project terms, flagging questions for review.

- Prepare clear project summaries showing contract amounts, documented changes, invoiced totals, payments, credits, and remaining balances.

- Flag disputed charges, missing approvals, and unsupported amounts for our review.

- Organize supporting documents so each amount can be traced to its source.

- Provide concise progress updates, maintain an unresolved-items list, and document a practical ongoing bookkeeping process.



**Requirements**



- Strong hands-on **QuickBooks Online** experience, including transaction matching, bookkeeping cleanup, and reconciliation troubleshooting.

- Bookkeeping experience with U.S. construction companies, remodelers, or contractors.

- Understanding of construction job costing, subcontractor payments, materials, change orders, and cost-plus billing.

- Experience reconstructing historical records and investigating discrepancies.

- Fluent spoken and written English, including the ability to explain financial questions clearly.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and gather questions into organized batches.

- Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Willingness to learn unfamiliar software with our guidance.

- Reliable internet, discretion with financial information, and availability for occasional Pacific Time calls.



**Expected results**



Accurate, traceable project financial histories; QuickBooks aligned with reconciled Uplinq records; organized project costs; and clear explanations of remaining differences. Project allocations must be verified against supporting documents, even when account totals are reconciled.



Changes affecting reconciled periods, opening balances, or accounting treatment require review with us or our accounting provider. We will handle client disputes and settlement decisions.



**To apply, please include:**



1. Your construction bookkeeping and QuickBooks Online experience.

2. An example of a historical cleanup you completed and how you verified accuracy.

3. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

4. A brief answer: A subcontractor payment appears in QuickBooks but is missing from the project’s job-cost report. How would you investigate and correct it without duplicating the expense?



We plan to begin with one project as a paid trial, with potential for additional cleanup projects and ongoing bookkeeping support.

title: Senior Airbnb/STR Guest Operations Specialist - Luxury Prop Management
description:

Our founding team previously built and sold a large Airbnb arbitrage business with strong systems, guest operations, and team structure. We are now building a new luxury STR management company and plan to scale quickly.



This is not a basic VA role. We need experienced STR operators with excellent English, strong judgment, professionalism, and the ability to help build systems as we grow.



Starting pay is 30,000 PHP/month because guest volume will be lighter upfront. As we scale, we want to reward great talent with raises as quickly as the company can afford.



Our goal is to provide 20 hours of guest coverage per day, 7 days per week, split between the first 3 guest operations hires. Weekend availability is required. We operate on U.S. Eastern Time. There may be 50–60 hours per week available for strong performers who want more hours and may be required in startup phase. Our goal for this company is to scale to 1000 luxury properties so we will likely have a very large team over the coming 6-12 months. Our founding members will be rewarded with larger roles if performance is top tier.

- Previous Airbnb experience as a Case Manager or higher-level support role

- Excellent written English

- Previous luxury str management role in addition to airbnb

- Experience handling guest communication for many properties at once

- Experience communicating with guests professionally, respectfully, and calmly

- Experience with Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and other OTA platforms

- Experience with Hostaway or another PMS/channel manager

- Experience with PriceLabs, AirDNA, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and AI tools

Responsibilities:



- Guest messaging

- Check-in and check-out support

- OTA issue resolution

- Airbnb claims and review management

- Cleaner and maintenance scheduling

- Vendor communication

- Organizing internal chats and Google Drive

- SOP and system building

- Vendor list building and light lead generation when guest volume is low



Early on, guest communication may be lighter, so we need someone flexible who can help across operations, systems, research, and organization.

7. Are you interested in 50–60 hours/week if available?

title: TradingView Pine Script & Backend Automation Developer (API / Webhooks)
description:
Job Title: TradingView Pine Script & Backend Automation Developer (API / Webhooks)

Rate: $6.00 – $7.00 USD per hour (depending on experience, speed and reliability)

Hours: Strictly capped at 4 to 6 hours per week

Job Description:

I am looking for a technical developer to build a custom "one-touch" trade execution system. The goal is to create a clickable UI panel directly inside TradingView that instantly routes orders to my exchange accounts (KuCoin, Binance) via backend webhooks and APIs.

You will be responsible for both the frontend chart interface and the backend server execution logic. Because this is a part-time, highly focused role, you will build the system in phases.

Key Responsibilities:

 * Pine Script UI: Build a custom on-chart panel with clickable buttons for Enter Long, Enter Short, Close, and Reverse.

 * Webhook & JSON Formatting: Configure the Pine Script buttons to instantly fire structured JSON payloads via TradingView alerts.

 * Backend API Execution: Set up the backend routing (via Node.js/Python on a VPS or a webhook connector) to catch the alerts and execute the trades on the exchange API.

 * Complex Order Logic: Program the "Reverse" button logic so it accurately calculates the current open position size, flattens it, executes the offsetting order, and automatically applies strict bracket orders (specifically 0.5x ATR trailing stop-loss buffers and fixed take-profits).

 * Testing: Build and test the system entirely on paper trading first. You will log executed Signal alerts to ensure triggers fire correctly. Live API keys will not be provided until the code passes a technical audit.

Work Environment & Payment Terms:

 * Time Tracking: All active working hours must be logged using Clockify.

 * Invoicing: You will submit your invoice every Friday based strictly on your Clockify hours.

 * Payouts: Guaranteed 48-hour payment window to process your payout over the weekend.

 * Communication: Daily project updates and alerts will be managed via Signal.

 * Code Management: All backend source code must be managed via private GitHub repositories.

How to Apply:

To ensure you have read this entire job post and possess the required attention to detail, please make the subject line of your application "ONE-TOUCH TRADING DEV". In your application message, please include:

 * Examples of interactive Pine Script UIs you have built.

 * A brief explanation of how you would structure the backend API to handle the "Reverse" position logic with strict stop-losses.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
Senior WordPress Developer — Online Bullion Dealer, London



About us



We're a London-based dealer in investment gold and silver bullion. We sell online and in store, and buy bullion back from customers. Every price on our site is live: our pricing engine updates each product's buy and sell price from the live gold and silver spot price.

We're growing fast, and our aim is clear: to become one of the UK's leading online bullion dealers.





The role



We're hiring a senior WordPress developer to own our e-commerce site end to end: speed, security, conversion, SEO and new features. The founder is handing the site over to focus on sales and marketing. You'll run it independently, bring the ideas, and explain your decisions in plain English.



Location: London · Hours: available 9am–5pm UK time · Type: [full-time/ part-time]

 

Stack: WordPress, WooCommerce, Elementor Pro, custom PHP, CSS and JavaScript, and third-party APIs, including a live metals price feed.



Take the site to the next level

This is the heart of the role. We want to be one of the UK's leading bullion sites, and we need a developer who can get us there.



That means a site that:

• carries a large and growing product range, all priced live, without slowing down;

• loads fast on every page and every device, even with prices updating constantly;

• gives customers a seamless journey, from first visit to checkout and back again when they sell.



You won't be handed a ticket list. You'll study the site, our competitors and the wider market, then come to us with ideas: what to build, what to fix, what to remove, and why. Every proposal comes with its expected impact, its risk and how you'll measure it.

You're a creative self-starter. You spot problems before customers do, focus on what moves the needle, and see work through to the finish.





What you'll own

1. Speed and scale. Fast pages on mobile and desktop as the product range grows. Get caching, scripts, CSS and images right, and keep heavy Elementor pages lean.

2. Security and stability. Keep the site up and protected from bots, scrapers and attacks, without blocking real customers or search engines. Backups, monitoring and safe updates.

3. Live pricing. Keep the pricing integration accurate, reliable and efficient. Prices must never be stale or wrong, and the feed must never slow the site down.

4. Conversion and customer experience. Improve product pages, filters, cart and checkout, especially on mobile. Find where customers drop off and fix it.

5. New features. Live gold and silver price charts, a customer portfolio dashboard that values holdings at live prices, price alerts, and a smoother sell-back flow.





SEO and GEO

Search is a core growth channel for us, so you need to understand it deeply, not treat it as an afterthought. You'll get the foundations right first, then keep building on them.



The foundations: technical SEO

• A clean site structure and internal linking across categories, products and guides.

• Crawling and indexing under control: sitemaps, robots rules, canonical tags, and product filters that don't create duplicate pages or waste crawl budget.

• Structured data: Product and Offer schema with live prices and stock, plus Organization, Breadcrumb and FAQ markup.

• Google Merchant Center product feeds kept in sync with live prices.

• Core Web Vitals that pass on mobile.

GEO: visibility in AI search

• Make the site easy for AI search tools such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity to understand, trust and cite.

• Structure our guides and product content to give clear, direct answers to the questions bullion buyers ask.

• Strengthen trust signals: consistent business details across the web, expert authorship and customer reviews.

Ongoing

• Track rankings, clicks and visibility in AI answers using Search Console and GA4.

• Keep up with how search is changing, and bring us specific, prioritised improvements.



What you'll need

• 5+ years of WordPress development, including live WooCommerce stores you've built, scaled and improved.

• Elementor and Elementor Pro, expert level: theme builder templates, loop grids, global styles, and knowing when custom code is the better choice.

• CSS and PHP: clean, responsive styles; custom functions, hooks and WooCommerce customisation; custom code managed safely.

• APIs: REST integrations and live data with JavaScript/AJAX, cached so it never slows the site.

• Performance: proven PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals gains on WooCommerce sites, with before and after numbers.

• SEO and GEO: hands-on technical SEO experience, with results you can show.

• Conversion and UX: proof that your changes increased sales or sign-ups.

• Security: WordPress hardening, firewall and bot management.

• A careful way of working: staging first, a backup before every change, a written undo plan and a change log. This is a live shop taking real payments.

• Clear communication: what you'll change, why, the risk, and how to undo it.

• You need to comfortable documenting all your work and reporting back to the founders with all your progress, results etc..





How to apply

Apply through this listing with:

1. Your CV.

2. A short note, 300 words maximum, on how you would help us become one of the UK's leading bullion sites. Be hyper specific: what you'd improve first, how, and why.

3. Links to 2–3 WordPress or WooCommerce sites you've built or improved, and what you did. Before and after speed scores, rankings or conversion figures are a plus.



Applications without the note won't be considered.



What happens next: we'll invite shortlisted candidates to an interview and a short practical assignment based on our site. We'll make our choice based on the results.

This involves:



- Researching prospects and identifying opportunities to improve their customer acquisition process.

- Starting conversations by offering useful insights rather than immediately pitching services.

- Building curiosity and trust before presenting an offer.

- Transitioning interested prospects into qualified sales appointments.



Experience with personalized Loom outreach, video prospecting, and permission-based sales conversations is highly desirable.



### 4. Client Success Support (Secondary Responsibility)



- Welcome new customers and assist with onboarding coordination.

- Conduct periodic client check-ins.

- Encourage customers to use their CRM, automations, and training resources.

- Monitor customer engagement and flag potential issues.

- Escalate technical questions to our dedicated 24/7 support team.

- Communicate internal updates through WhatsApp and Slack.



Your primary responsibility is appointment setting and lead conversion. Client success responsibilities will expand as the company grows.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous experience in B2B appointment setting, cold calling, or sales development.

- **Hands-on experience using GoHighLevel (GHL)** to manage contacts, pipelines, appointments, and follow-ups.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners.

- Strong objection-handling, rapport-building, and qualification skills.

- Experience using **WhatsApp and Slack** for professional communication and team coordination.

- Familiarity with Instagram,
 Messenger, SMS, and
 outreach.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-up sequences.

- Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet workspace.

- Availability during U.S. business hours.

- Organized, coachable, proactive, and comfortable working toward performance targets.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with Trojan Horse outreach or other value-first prospecting methodologies.

- Experience creating or coordinating personalized Loom video audits.

- Experience working with marketing agencies, SaaS companies, or fitness businesses.

- Experience managing inbound leads from Meta advertising campaigns.

- Understanding of CRM automation and AI appointment-setting workflows.

- Experience assisting with customer onboarding or client success.



## What We Provide



- An existing database of fitness business prospects.

- Established sales processes, scripts, and qualification guidelines.

- Access to GoHighLevel and our appointment scheduling tools.

- Two days of initial training, followed by ongoing coaching.

- A dedicated technical support team.

- Performance-based bonus opportunities.

- Opportunity to grow into a larger sales and client success role.



## Compensation & Performance Bonuses



**Base Salary:** $500 USD/month  

**Schedule:** 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday  

**Performance Bonus:** $10 for every qualified sales appointment that actually attends.



Bonuses are paid for qualified appointments that attend their scheduled sales calls, not simply appointments booked.



A qualified appointment must be with an active fitness business owner or authorized decision-maker who meets our qualification criteria and has a genuine interest in improving their client acquisition process.



Bonuses are earned regardless of whether the prospect purchases our services.



**Initial Evaluation:** 30-day paid trial, with opportunities for increased compensation and responsibilities based on performance.

We measure success through:



- Qualified sales conversations.

- Qualified appointments booked.

- Appointment attendance and show rates.

- Consistent prospect follow-up.

- Accurate CRM management.

- Clear communication and accountability.



Our initial goal is to develop a consistent pipeline of qualified sales appointments. We value appointment quality over inflated booking numbers.



## How to Apply

1. A brief introduction explaining your B2B appointment-setting experience.

3. Your experience with GoHighLevel, including which features you've used.

6. Your average daily call volume and typical appointment-setting results.

8. Your availability to work U.S. business hours.



**Important:** Start your application with the words "GAINS Appointment Setter" so we know you've read the full description.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live interview. 



We're looking for someone who is interested in growing with CipherSway Solutions, takes ownership of their results, and understands how to turn meaningful conversations into qualified sales opportunities and in return we are looking to grow with you.

title: Clinic Compliance Analyst
description:
JOB OVERVIEW 



Job Location: Remote 



Job Type: Full-Time | Remote 



Department: Compliance 



Reports To: Director of Compliance 



Shift: 9AM to 5:30 PM (EST) 



Direct Report(s): No 



 



OVERVIEW 



This role, reporting to the Director of Compliance, is central to safeguarding the integrity of our 340B clinic program. The Clinic Compliance Analyst reviews dispense, eligibility, and ordering data for covered entity clinics, with particular emphasis on infusion visits. The analyst identifies inaccuracies, uncovers patterns in recurring errors, and partners with IT, Compliance, and other internal departments to correct them at the root. EMR access is used to verify eligibility and substantiate findings in the patient chart. 



 



RESPONSIBILITIES 



1. Clinic Data Review 



Review dispense, eligibility, and ordering data for infusion visits to identify inaccurate, incomplete, or ineligible records. 



Confirm that each dispense aligns with the visit, patient, product, and quantity documented. 



Interpret medication quantities, package sizes, and billing units against orders and visit records. 



Identify recurring error patterns, document their root causes, and recommend corrective action. 



2. EMR Eligibility and Chart Research 



Access EMR systems to verify patient eligibility and locate chart documentation, infusion notes, and procedure codes. 



Reconcile infusion note details against clinic dispense records. 



Document findings so that each conclusion can be traced to its source. 



3. Reporting, Workbooks, and Validation 



Validate reporting prepared by the Director and Compliance team before it is shared with clients or executives. 



Develop and maintain Excel workbooks and Power Query queries, continually refining them for efficiency. 



Identify data issues and partner with IT and other internal departments to resolve them. 



Preserve copies of reports and supporting data to support audit readiness. 



Understand how clinic data flows to the compliance database, auditors, and other parties that require it. 



4. Audits and Compliance Monitoring 



Execute monthly audits for each assigned clinic, ensuring compliance with stakeholder requirements. 



Monitor eligibility and payor data for compliance risk, escalating findings promptly. 



Support internal and external audit preparation with thorough, traceable documentation. 



Help safeguard systems against duplicate discounts and diversion. 



 



QUALIFICATIONS 



Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, data analytics, or a related analytical field, or equivalent work experience. 



Minimum of 2 years of experience in 340B program operations, clinic or infusion billing, revenue cycle, or a similar healthcare data role. 



Working knowledge of medication and billing data, including NDCs, HCPCS codes, billing units, and infusion documentation. 



Demonstrated ability to navigate EMR systems to locate chart documentation and match it to dispense records. 



Proficiency in Power Query for secure data access, with advanced Excel skills. 



Excellent analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking abilities with a keen eye for detail and data integrity. 



Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 



Preferred Qualifications 



Experience with how clinic data flows for auditors and other parties that require it. 



SQL experience for querying databases. 



Hands on experience with an EMR platform used by infusion clinics.

title: WordPress, Elementor & SEO Specialist
description:
Job title: WordPress (Elementor Pro) & SEO/AEO Specialist — Website Improvement Project (Freelance, Part-Time)



About Heads Up:



Heads Up is a UK leadership development business that helps primary school headteachers move their schools from good to great.



Our founder, Sonia Gill, is a school leadership expert, speaker and trainer. Our work includes leadership programmes (Journey to Excellence), a headteacher Mastermind group, training on Successful Difficult Conversations, and a weekly leadership tips
 read by school leaders across the UK.



Our audience is busy, intelligent and experienced headteachers. Our website needs to feel practical, human and authoritative, and help them quickly see that we understand their problems.



About the project:



We're looking for an experienced WordPress and SEO specialist to put our new website copy live, restructure our navigation, and improve 
 SEO ranking in Google and cited in AI answer tools.



We've rewritten our website to speak to the problems headteachers face, rather than leading with our products. The copy is drafted. Now we need someone who can:



- Build it well in Elementor Pro, on existing and new pages

- Find the keyphrases and questions headteachers actually search for and ask in AI tools

- Fix the technical issues flagged by Ahrefs and PageSpeed Insights, and make every page work well on phones and tablets

- Shape the pages so that Google and AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) understand them and choose to show them



This is a fixed-scope freelance project of about 8 weeks, not an ongoing role. The site has 51 pages and around 169 blog posts, and runs on WordPress with Elementor Pro and Yoast SEO. There may be an ongoing retainer afterwards if the project goes well.



What you'll do:



Build pages in Elementor Pro

- Update existing pages with our new, already-drafted copy

- Design and build new pages, using reusable templates and global styles so our team can edit them later

- Create and edit images: properly licensed, compressed and with descriptive alt text

- Check everything on desktop, tablet and mobile



Mobile responsiveness

- Check every page and the blog post template on phones and tablets, in Elementor and on real iPhone and Android devices

- Fix layouts so sections stack cleanly, with no sideways scrolling or overlapping elements

- Set readable font sizes, spacing and images for each screen size

- Make buttons, menus and forms (including our sign-up and enquiry forms) easy to use on a phone

- Keep the same content on mobile as on desktop, since Google ranks sites on their mobile version



Navigation and site structure

- Build our new main, footer and mobile menus to an agreed sitemap

- Set up 301 redirects from old URLs, retire out-of-date pages, and update internal links



Keyphrase research and metadata

- Research the keyphrases and questions headteachers use, with volume, difficulty and intent

- Produce a keyphrase map: one primary keyphrase per page, with no two pages competing

- Write unique SEO titles and meta descriptions for every page in Yoast SEO



Technical SEO and speed

- Fix issues flagged by Ahrefs: missing alt text, broken links, duplicate meta descriptions and titles

- Improve page load time and Core Web Vitals on an Elementor site

- Check sitemaps, robots.txt and canonical tags, and resubmit in Google Search Console



SEO and AEO copy optimisation

- Set a single H1 and a clear heading structure on every page

- Adapt copy for AI answers: question-style headings, short direct answers, FAQ sections

- Add schema markup (Organisation, Person, FAQ, Event, Course)

- Strengthen internal linking between pages and blog posts

- Keep the meaning and Sonia's voice; larger copy changes go to Sonia for approval



Report and hand over

- Record baselines at the start and show before-and-after results at the end

- Log what keyphrases and meta descriptions have been used per URL.

- Leave us a short guide and screen recording so we can maintain the pages



What this project isn't

- Not copywriting from scratch. The copy is written; you adapt it for SEO and AEO

- Not a full redesign or rebuild. We're staying on WordPress and Elementor Pro

- Not link building, paid ads or social media

- Not an ongoing role, though there may be follow-on work



What we're looking for:



Essential

- 3+ years building and editing WordPress sites, with strong Elementor Pro skills (templates, global styles, theme builder, mobile and tablet layouts)

- A portfolio of Elementor sites that look professional, work well on phones and load quickly

- Proven SEO results: examples where your work improved rankings or organic traffic, with numbers

- Hands-on keyphrase research with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush or Google Search Console

- Technical SEO: redirects, broken links, metadata, canonical tags, sitemaps, schema markup

- Page speed optimisation on Elementor sites, with before-and-after PageSpeed Insights results

- Understanding of AEO (answer engine optimisation, also called GEO): how content gets picked up by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity, and evidence you've applied it

- Yoast SEO (or Rank Math) experience

- Basic image creation and editing (Canva, Photoshop or similar), with a clear understanding of image licensing

- Excellent written English and close attention to detail

- Reliable: you meet deadlines and tell us early if something is at risk



Nice to have

- Experience with UK clients, education or professional-services websites

- Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console reporting

- Accessibility (WCAG) basics

- Experience with WordPress caching and performance plugins (e.g. WP Rocket) and image optimisation tools



Timeline, budget and how we work

Length: 8 weeks, in five phases: audit and research, build, technical fixes, launch, handover. We believe we will need ongoing support after this project.



Fee: PHP 85,000 total for the full 8-week project (equivalent to PHP 42,500 per 4 weeks). This is a fixed-scope freelance project, not a permanent monthly salaried position.



Trial: phase 1 (audit, keyphrase research and keyphrase map) is a paid first stage. If it goes well, we continue to the build.



Hours per week: 25



How we work:

1. A 30-minute video call each week with Phil, plus a shared tracker

2. All work built and reviewed on draft pages before going live

3. No new plugins or hosting changes without our agreement

4. Everything is created in Heads Up's own accounts, and all images and fonts are properly licensed



Start date: January 2027



How to apply:



Please send:

1. Links to 2–3 Elementor Pro sites you've built or improved, with a note on what you did on each (we'll look at them on a phone as well as a computer)

2. One SEO case study: what you changed, and the ranking or traffic results, with numbers

3. One example of AEO work: content you optimised to appear in AI answers or Google AI Overviews, and what happened

4. Before-and-after PageSpeed Insights results from a site you've sped up

5. A short answer (under 150 words): looking at 
, what are the first three things you'd fix, and why?



Please start your application with the words "Good to Great" so we know you've read this in full.



Application Deadline: Wednesday, 25 November 2026, at 9:00 AM GMT

SENIOR E-COMMERCE CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST 

Full-Time · Long-Term · Above-Market Pay for the Right Person



ABOUT US

We run 2 fast-growing e-commerce brands for natural health products. Our customers are in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and right now we are scaling hard into Black Friday and December.



We are building a lean, high-quality support setup: our AI drafts every reply, and one experienced specialist makes sure every answer that goes out is right. We are looking for that ONE person, long-term.



This is NOT an entry-level job. We want the best, and we are willing to pay more for real experience.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Be the human in the loop: our AI drafts the answer to every
 and chat. You check each draft against the order and the customer's full history, fix what is wrong, and send it.

- Make our AI better: your corrections are used to improve it. The better your judgment, the better the whole system gets.

- Handle order questions: tracking, delivery delays, address changes and cancellations

- Process returns, refunds and refused parcels, and coordinate them with our fulfillment warehouse

- Calm down upset customers and save the order where possible

- Keep tickets organized and close them cleanly. No customer gets forgotten.

- Spot recurring problems and report them, so we fix the cause and not just the ticket

- Give us honest feedback on our support tool and processes. We improve them together.

FEEDBACK AND MISTAKES GIVE ALL OF US THE BEST OPPORTUNITY TO GROW!

- Excellent written English; German is a big plus but not required

- Calm, patient and solution-oriented, even when a customer is rude or threatens you

- Clear processes and a support tool we built ourselves

HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)

1. A video (5-10 minutes), recorded with Loom or uploaded to Google Drive. Please set the link to "anyone with the link can view". In the video, tell us:

We take pride in delivering an exceptional client experience, staying organized, communicating consistently, and making what can be a complicated process feel seamless for our clients.



We already have a dedicated transaction coordinator handling contracts and closings. This position focuses on everything around that: listing preparation, contractor coordination, seller and buyer communication, marketing support, CRM management, and the past-client relationships that keep our business growing.



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for tasks. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates what needs to happen next, and helps us operate at a higher level.



Ideally, you're the person who starts the day by telling us what's due, what's slipping, what needs our attention, and what you've already handled.



HOW WE WORK

You prepare, we approve, and you execute.

You'll draft personalized client communications, prepare updates, and manage follow-through. Important client-facing messages require agent approval, while routine administrative communication can be handled independently using our approved processes.



Your drafts should be accurate, thoughtful, and close to send-ready. We value warm, natural communication that sounds like a real person, not a generic template.



Once a plan is approved, you run it.

When we've established the scope and dates for a listing, you coordinate the contractors, confirm appointments, organize the details, and follow through until the work is complete.



We shouldn't have to remind you to check on an overdue estimate or confirm whether a painter finished before the cleaners arrive.



You don't need permission for every routine step. You follow our processes, take initiative, and bring us solutions when something needs our attention.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Listing Preparation & Contractor Coordination

This is the most important responsibility of the position.

• Request bids from painters, cleaners, handymen, landscapers, flooring contractors, stagers, photographers, and other vendors.

• Build and maintain detailed listing preparation schedules for sellers.

• Schedule approved work, confirm appointments, and coordinate vendor access according to team procedures.

• Follow up on outstanding estimates, incomplete work, delays, and missed appointments before we have to ask.

• Identify scheduling conflicts and proactively recommend solutions.

• Track contractor progress and keep listing timelines on schedule.

• Organize bids, invoices, photos, and project updates in each listing's Slack channel and designated folders.

• Prepare seller-facing schedules and progress updates.

• Ensure cleaning, staging, photography, and marketing deadlines are coordinated.

• Communicate with our transaction coordinator when a handoff is needed, without duplicating responsibilities.

We want someone who can take a listing preparation plan and own the administrative execution from beginning to end.



2. Active Listings & Seller Communication

• Monitor showing activity and maintain accurate showing logs.

• Call, text, and
 showing agents to request feedback.

• Track interested buyers and agents, outstanding feedback, and promised follow-ups.

• Draft our Monday, Wednesday, and Friday seller updates with showing activity, feedback, and upcoming appointments.

• Help coordinate open house preparation and post-open-house follow-up.

• Draft price improvement, open house, and offer deadline communications for agent approval.

• Keep agents informed of meaningful activity or situations requiring immediate attention.

Our clients should never have to wonder what's happening with their homes.



3. Buyer Support & Communication

• Set up a Slack channel for each buyer with their information and preferences.

• Help schedule and coordinate showing appointments.

• Research property information for pre-inspection
s, including available permits through PortlandMaps, Oregon DEQ oil tank records, and available radon-related information.

• Prepare accurate buyer communication drafts using our approved templates and procedures.

• Track outstanding buyer questions, appointments, and follow-up commitments.

The goal is to help our agents provide timely, thoughtful service without having to personally manage every administrative detail.



4. CRM, Leads & Client Relationships

• Enter new leads and referrals into our CRM the same business day.

• Maintain accurate contact information, lead sources, rankings, pipeline stages, and transaction history.

• Keep lead trackers and other key reports up to date, including Monday and Friday reporting.

• Identify leads or clients who need attention and flag them to the appropriate agent.

• Manage birthdays, home anniversaries, referral thank-yous, client gifts, and other relationship milestones.

• Prepare personalized cards, notes, and gift suggestions for approval.

• Coordinate approved gifts and client touches, then record them accurately.

• Track client reviews and testimonials and prepare follow-up communications.

• Help maintain relationships with past clients and referral partners through approved outreach.

We want someone who thinks beyond checking boxes.

Look for thoughtful ways we can improve our clients' experience, recognize important moments, and stay connected.

If you notice a client has an upcoming home anniversary, a referral partner deserves a thank-you, or someone hasn't heard from us in a while, we want you bringing that to our attention with a suggested next step.

Helping our clients feel genuinely cared for is a major part of this position.



5. Listing Marketing & Administrative Support

• Create and update listing flyers, brochures, "What's Nearby" sheets, open house materials, postcards, and other marketing pieces using our Canva templates.

• Research neighborhood amenities and nearby businesses accurately, including names, locations, and verified walking or driving times when needed.

• Organize listing photos, property information, marketing assets, and agent details.

• Prepare listing announcements, social media posts, open house promotions, and marketing
s.

• Draft and coordinate our monthly newsletter.

• Update marketing when prices, property information, photos, or listing details change.

• Keep marketing materials organized, accurate, and consistent with our team branding.



6. Daily Operations, Systems & Accountability

• Review all active projects and outstanding tasks at the beginning of each day.

• Send a concise morning overview of priorities, upcoming deadlines, and items needing attention.

• Maintain accurate task lists, schedules, and project trackers.

• Follow through on outstanding items without requiring repeated reminders.

• Proactively flag risks, delays, or decisions that require an agent's involvement.

• Send a brief end-of-day recap showing completed work, outstanding items, and priorities for the following day.

• Create, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for recurring responsibilities.

• Recommend improvements to systems and workflows that help our team become more efficient.

Our expectation is simple: We should feel more organized and less overwhelmed because you're part of our team.



HOW WE PRIORITIZE

This is a dynamic position, and not every responsibility has the same urgency.

Your first priority is keeping active clients, listing preparation projects, appointments, and time-sensitive communication on track.

Your second priority is maintaining an excellent client experience, including buyer follow-ups, new leads, referrals, and past-client relationships.

Marketing, larger CRM projects, database cleanup, and other administrative work are scheduled around those responsibilities.

We value good judgment and the ability to recognize what matters most without needing constant direction.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required Qualifications

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Confident communicating by phone with U.S. real estate agents, clients, contractors, and service providers.

• At least 2 years of experience supporting a U.S. business as a VA, executive assistant, operations assistant, or similar role.

• Strong organizational and project management abilities.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Comfortable managing multiple projects and competing deadlines.

• Persistent, professional follow-through.

• Ability to write warm, natural, professional
s.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

• Comfortable learning software and improving workflows.

• Reliable internet, backup power or internet access, a quiet workspace, and a webcam.

• Available full-time, five days per week during U.S. Pacific business hours.



Highly Preferred

• Experience supporting a U.S. residential real estate team.

• Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, listing preparation, or other multi-step projects.

• Familiarity with Sphere CRM, Flodesk, Canva, Slack, Google Workspace, RMLS, Zillow, or Redfin.

• Experience preparing client communications and marketing materials.

• Experience writing SOPs or improving administrative systems.

• Previous responsibility for managing a busy executive's priorities or operating independently.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Every listing has an accurate preparation schedule and clearly documented next steps.

• Every contractor has a confirmed plan, and overdue bids, appointments, or projects are promptly addressed.

• Sellers receive their Monday, Wednesday, and Friday updates on time.

• Buyer check-ins and follow-ups are prepared consistently.

• New leads and referrals are entered into the CRM promptly.

• Client anniversaries, birthdays, gifts, and referral thank-yous are organized and never forgotten.

• Client communication drafts require minimal editing.

• Outstanding tasks and deadlines are visible and consistently managed.

• You bring us solutions and recommendations, not just questions.

• Our agents have more time to work directly with clients and grow the business.



SCOPE OF THE POSITION

This is an administrative operations position. Licensed real estate activities, including pricing advice, negotiations, and other decisions requiring a real estate license, remain the responsibility of our licensed agents.

You will coordinate approved work and communications using our documented procedures, with support and direction from the team.



WHY JOIN US?

This is a long-term, full-time position with an established real estate team that genuinely values client relationships, professionalism, and attention to detail.

You'll work directly with the team's agents, have meaningful responsibility, and play an important role in how we operate and care for our clients.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, improve systems, take pride in their work, and become a trusted part of our business.

Compensation: Negotiable.



HOW TO APPLY

We review every application carefully and want to get to know the person behind the résumé.



Please apply through this form: 



The form takes about 20 minutes. Before you start, have these ready:

1. A link to your résumé (Google Drive or Dropbox, set to viewable).

2. A link to a 2-minute introduction video (Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube, set to viewable). In the video, tell us:

    – About your experience and why you're interested in this position.

    – About a time you noticed something important your manager had missed and acted before it became a problem.

    – How you'd handle coordinating five contractors across two listings when one falls behind schedule.



We're not looking for a polished video. We want to hear you communicate naturally and see how you think.



Only complete applications submitted through the form will be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Appointment Setter for Top US Cosmetic Dentists (Excellent English, Full Time)
description:
Hi! We are a marketing agency that works with the top cosmetic dentists in Beverly Hills, one of the best in New York City, one of the best in Denver, and top practices in other cities across the U.S.



Our system brings in leads and booked appointments that are already pre-sold. Your job is to turn them into consults that actually show up.



Because the leads are pre-sold, the volume is lower than a normal call center, but the quality is 10X higher. Quality is what we care about.



We are hiring 2 setters. This is a long-term, full-time role.





YOUR JOB (judged on 5 things, pass or fail)



1. Call every new lead and booked appointment within 5 minutes, during work hours

2. Reply to our dental clients in Discord within 1 hour, during work hours

3. Keep the CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) up to date every day, with clear notes after every call

4. Follow up on every lead and confirm every booked consult, by call and text

5. Get booked consults to show up





PAY



$500 USD per month base, plus $50 for every appointment that shows up.



What you can earn per month:

- 20 shows = $1,500

- 40 shows = $2,500

- 80 shows = $4,500



We already had 20 appointments in the first 11 days of November. There are also extra bonuses for hitting your numbers consistently.





SCHEDULE



U.S. business hours in each client's local time (Eastern, Mountain and Pacific). In Manila time this is a night shift, starting around 10 PM. Your exact hours depend on which clients you cover.





MUST HAVE (non negotiable)



- Extremely clear English that U.S. patients understand easily

- Comfortable on the phone all day

- Past experience as an appointment setter, call center agent, or in phone sales or customer service

- A fast learner

- A perfectionist who doesn't make excuses

- Proactive. You don't need to be told every step

- Available full time on the night shift

- Reliable computer, fast internet, a headset and a quiet place to work

- A backup plan if your power or internet goes out



NICE TO HAVE



- GoHighLevel experience

- Dental, medical or healthcare appointment setting experience





HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will be ignored)



1. Start your application with the words "purple monkey".



2. Send a 60 to 90 second Loom or Vocaroo recording so I can hear your English clearly. In the recording:



   a) Read this out loud like a real call:

   "Hi Sarah, this is (your name) calling from Dr. Smith's office. I'm calling to confirm your smile consultation tomorrow at 2 PM. Dr. Smith has set this time aside just for you, so I wanted to make sure it still works. Perfect! You'll get a text with the address in a few minutes. Is there anything you'd like the doctor to know before you come in?"



3. Tell me where you've done phone work before and for how long.

title: Experienced Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Experienced Short-Form Video Editor for Instagram Reels



We’re looking for an EXPERIENCED short-form video editor with a strong portfolio and an understanding of viewer retention, pacing, and storytelling. This is NOT an entry-level role. You should be comfortable turning raw footage into polished, engaging videos with minimal direction.



Most videos are under 60 seconds and require clean, intentional cutting, with captions, B-roll, overlays, and sound effects. We value strong editing judgment over excessive effects.



Responsibilities



- Review raw footage and select the strongest takes and clips.



- Create a strong opening, natural flow, and engaging pacing.



- Remove pauses, filler words, repetition, and weaker sections.



- Add captions, B-roll, overlays, and sound effects when appropriate.



- Follow provided references and deliver polished videos on schedule.



Requirements:



Proven experience editing Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts for creators.



Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and audience retention.



Ability to make editorial decisions independently without step-by-step instructions.



Attention to detail, reliable communication, and proficiency in your preferred editing software.
