title: Virtual Assistant – Generalist (Digital Marketing Experience Only)
description:
• Location: Remote (Work from Home) / Hybrid

• Salary: ₱25,000 - ₱35,000/month DOE (Depending on Experience)

• Employment Type: Full-time

• Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Philippine Time) or Flexible



About Sparkblaze Digital



Sparkblaze Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency dedicated to helping startups and growing

businesses ignite growth with innovative, results-driven strategies. Our team builds and manages data

driven campaigns — from paid advertising and SEO to landing pages and conversion rate optimization —

that generate measurable ROI for our clients.



We work across a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, real estate, home

services, and local businesses, helping each one scale smarter and grow faster with tailored strategies.

We are a fully remote team transitioning to a hybrid and face to face set-up, and we are looking for a

fresh, eager, and adaptable VA Generalist who is ready to learn the digital marketing business from the

ground up and support our team across a wide variety of tasks.

Here, your work does more than grow brands. Every client we serve is making the world better in some

way, from charitable causes and mold and environmental testing that protects people's health, to

organizations that donate to and uplift the youth. Start your digital marketing career with campaigns

that deliver real results and support causes that truly matter.



What You'll Do



As a VA Generalist, you will provide flexible, day-to-day support to our team and clients across a variety

of administrative, operational, and digital marketing tasks. You will start with general virtual assistant

work and gradually be trained in areas such as media buying, reporting, and campaign support. You will

be a go-to person who is willing to take on whatever the team needs.



Your responsibilities may include:

• Handling general virtual assistant tasks such as
 and inbox management, calendar

scheduling, data entry, document preparation, and file organization.

• Supporting account managers and team leads with client coordination, follow-ups, and meeting

notes.

• Assisting with research tasks such as competitor research, keyword research, audience research,

and lead list building.

• Learning and supporting paid media tasks, including campaign setup assistance, ad copy and

creative uploads, and monitoring of Google Ads and Meta Ads under the guidance of senior

media buyers.

• Helping prepare weekly and monthly performance reports using spreadsheets, dashboards, and

templates provided by the team.

• Assisting with basic tracking and tool checks (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel) as you are

trained.

• Supporting the creative, SEO, and web teams with content posting, basic landing page updates,

and quality checks.

• Updating project management tools and CRMs (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp, HubSpot) to keep

tasks, leads, and deadlines organized.

• Helping document and follow the team's standard operating procedures (SOPs), and suggesting

improvements as you learn.

• Taking on other tasks and special projects as assigned by the team, with a positive attitude and a

willingness to learn.



What Are We Looking For?



We are looking for an adaptable, reliable, and quick-learning fresh graduate who is excited to start a

career in digital marketing. You do not need to be an expert, but you should be willing to learn new

things every day, follow instructions carefully, and take ownership of the tasks given to you in a fast

paced agency environment.



You should have:

• A completed bachelor's degree in any course (fresh graduates are strongly encouraged to apply;

no prior work experience required).

• Willingness to learn new skills such as media buying, reporting, and digital marketing tools, with

the drive to grow into more advanced roles.

• Committed and loyal team members who are looking to build a long-term career with us and

grow alongside the team.

• General knowledge of virtual assistant tasks such as
 management, scheduling, data entry,

research, and document handling.

• Basic working knowledge of Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google

Drive) and Microsoft Office tools.

• Flexibility and the ability to work on anything asked of you, from admin tasks to marketing

support, and to switch between tasks and priorities quickly.

• Good analytical and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to organize information and spot

mistakes before they become problems.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including clear updates and

professional communication with teammates and clients.

• Comfort learning and using project management tools and CRMs (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp,

HubSpot); prior exposure is a plus but not required.

• Familiarity with or curiosity about digital marketing, social media, and advertising platforms

(Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok) is a plus.

• Willingness to work flexible hours to align with clients or team members in different time zones.

• Someone who has a stable and reliable internet connection.

• Who has a working, well-conditioned device (laptop or desktop).

• Backup devices available to ensure uninterrupted workflow in case of emergency.



Who Are We Looking For?



We are looking for A-players — individuals who are hungry, curious, and take full ownership of their

growth and their results.



• Adaptable: Open to doing anything the team needs and comfortable switching between

different types of tasks.

• Eager to Learn: Excited to pick up new skills such as media buying, reporting, and digital

marketing tools.

• Accountable: Owns wins and misses alike, and follows through without needing to be chased.

• Proactive: Anticipates needs, asks smart questions, and takes initiative rather than waiting to be

told what to do.

• Coachable: Takes feedback well and continuously improves their craft.

• Detail-Oriented: Double-checks work, follows instructions carefully, and keeps things organized.

• A Strong Communicator: Gives clear updates, asks for clarification when needed, and works well

with teammates and clients alike.

• A Team Player: Supports the team, shares the workload, and raises the standard for everyone

around them.

• Curious & Growth-Oriented: Always learning, testing, and keeping up with the latest in digital

marketing.



Why Join Sparkblaze Digital

title: Illustrator & Character Designer (Remote Contract, Singapore Creative App Studio))
description:
Hi! We're SheepWorks, a Singapore creative studio. Our slogan is "Extraordinary, Made Simple." and our mission is to transform everyday apps into simple, thoughtful and engaging experiences through our own products and apps.



Our brand is led by a cast of sheep characters: flat 2D, sticker-style, thick outlines, with snappy, bouncy motion. Polished and playful, calm and friendly, a little cheeky but always trustworthy. We work by three values: Integrity, Ownership and Agility.



We're looking for an illustrator and character designer on a remote contract. You'll be our story artist. You'll shape how our sheep characters look, feel and tell stories: in comics, sticker packs, social graphics and the storyboards behind every video.



You'll start once our mascot foundation (the model sheet) is finalised, and build our character bible on it: turnarounds, expressions and a style guide. Our 2D Animator then animates, edits and posts the videos from your storyboards and files.



How a week works: You will suggest the storyboard based on an abstract high-level idea, you storyboard it and prepare the assets, the animator animates, edits and posts, our design and creative leads review, and our founder approves the week's content.



The contract

- Remote contract (independent contractor)

- Full-time workload (about 40 hours a week), 9am - 6pm Singapore time (flexible)

- Paid via Wise

- Work is for SheepWorks accounts plus other assigned accounts/tasks



What you'll do

- Build and keep up our character bible on the established mascot foundation: turnarounds, expressions and a style guide

- Design new characters and variants, delivered as animation-ready layered files

- Storyboard each video from a short premise or script into key frames, poses, backgrounds and props

- Make comics, sticker packs, static social graphics, thumbnails and key art

- Style-check animated clips so they stay on-model before our design and creative review

- Deliver finished files with prepared captions into our content calendar

- Hand over tidy, layered source files with every delivery



What we're looking for

- A portfolio with mascot or character design work, bonus if its original IP mascot drafted by you from scratch.

- Storyboarding plus comic and visual storytelling skills

- Strong flat 2D, sticker-style illustration that stays consistently on-model

- Animation-ready source files (layered or vector)

- Knowing how to use AI tools effectively to work faster (see "How we use AI")

- Able to deliver original work and full source files

- A strong ownership mindset: you take a task from brief to done

- Available for agreed check-in times within SGT business hours

- Reliable internet and power so you can meet agreed deadlines (backup recommended)

- A quiet place for a video call

- Clear written English and reliable communication



Nice-to-haves

- Preparing artwork in parts for animation (e.g. for Rive or Spine)

- Mascot or character design for apps

- Short, friendly caption writing for social posts

- A sense of humour that fits a calm, slightly cheeky brand



How we use AI

We want you to use AI well, not lean on it.

- AI is fine for ideas, reference, cleanup, upscaling and captions, but final characters and key art must be hand-drawn by you, and AI use is always declared.

- Your output must be primarily hand-crafted, not majority AI-generated. AI assists; it never replaces original character art

- Tell us which AI tools you use and how, in your application, your test and your work with us



The test

If you're shortlisted, we'll send you a short free storyboard test.

The brief: "Our mascot (a sheep) tries to make the perfect cup of coffee — and it goes wrong."

- Story: 15–20 seconds, with a setup, escalation, twist and payoff

- Deliver 6 rough panels (greyscale is fine), each with a one-line action note, a camera note and any dialogue or sound cue

- AI: hand-drawn; AI only for ideas and reference, and declared

- Time: about 2–3 hours, due within 3 days

- Format: return it as one PDF or image



How hiring works

1. Fill in our application form

2. The test below

3. A live walkthrough call of your work



How to apply

Please apply through our application form:





Start your application message with the word FLEECE so we know you read this far.



We read every application. Thanks for your interest, and we'd love to see your characters!



How you work

We look for people who work the way we do. Three values guide us: Integrity, Ownership and Agility.

- Integrity: you are transparent about how you work, honest about what is and isn't working, and you do what you believe is right even when a shortcut would be easier. You keep your word, raise problems early, and treat unpublished work and source files with care.

- Ownership: you care about the finished result, not just the task in front of you. You take work from brief to done, think about what happens after you hand it over, and would put your name on what you ship. If you see a better way, you say so, and you take the same kind of feedback without ego.

- Agility: you stay curious, learn quickly, try things and adapt as the brief, the tools or the feedback changes. You would rather test an idea than debate it for too long.

title: Senior Business Operations VA
description:
SENIOR BUSINESS OPERATIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT - NEW VENTURE DEVELOPMENT



Remote  |  Full-Time / Long-Term  |  Reports to Founder



This is a VA role, but it is not primarily administrative. We are looking for someone who understands how a business works end to end.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant / Business Operations professional who has had deep exposure to the inner workings of a U.S.-based business.

This is not an entry-level administrative VA position.

We are specifically looking for someone who has worked closely with a business owner, founder, GM, or senior management team and has seen how a business operates end to end.

You may have been an Executive Assistant, Operations Manager, Senior VA, Chief of Staff, General Manager, Project Manager, or similar. Your title matters less than your actual experience.

Have you been close enough to the business to understand how it actually works?

Our founder builds and invests in new businesses. You will work directly with him to research, plan, launch, and eventually help operate new ventures.

We want someone who can bring practical knowledge from businesses they have already worked in and apply that experience to building new ones.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will help the founder understand, evaluate, build, and operate new businesses.

Break down how different businesses operate from customer acquisition through fulfillment

Research competitors, pricing, vendors, software, staffing, and business models

Help determine how a business should be structured and launched

Build operating plans, workflows, SOPs, and processes

Identify vendors, suppliers, contractors, employees, and technology needed to operate the business

Understand and document how leads are generated, sold, fulfilled, and serviced

Help develop pricing and revenue models

Identify operational risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities

Coordinate vendors, contractors, employees, and outside partners

Help recruit and manage team members

Track business performance and identify problems

Take increasing ownership of new ventures once they launch

This role will involve both thinking and execution. One day you may be researching how an industry works. The next you may be interviewing vendors, building a workflow, hiring someone, reviewing unit economics, or solving an operational problem.



THE TYPE OF EXPERIENCE WE WANT

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked inside a U.S.-based small or medium-sized business and had exposure to many parts of the company.

For example, you should be comfortable explaining:

What the company sold

Who the customers were

How customers found the company

How leads were converted into sales

How pricing worked

How the company delivered its product or service

How employees and contractors were managed

Which vendors or outside partners were important

What software and systems ran the business

What the major expenses were

Where operational problems typically occurred

How customer complaints or service issues were handled

What metrics the owner cared about

What you would change if you were building the company again

You do not need to have owned the business yourself.

However, we are looking for someone who was close enough to the operation that they genuinely understood how the business worked rather than simply completing isolated administrative tasks.



IDEAL BACKGROUND

You may be a strong fit if you have previously worked as a:

Senior Virtual Assistant

Executive Assistant to a business owner

Operations Manager

Business Operations Specialist

Chief of Staff

General Manager

Project Manager

Operations-focused Executive Assistant

Senior administrative professional with significant operational responsibility

Experience working directly with a U.S. entrepreneur or small-business owner is strongly preferred.



SKILLS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You should have strong experience in several of the following:

Business operations

Sales and business development

Marketing and customer acquisition

Customer service

Hiring and recruiting

Vendor management

Operations and fulfillment

Pricing

Basic financial analysis

Process development

SOP creation

Project management

Research

Managing employees or contractors

You should also be:

Highly resourceful

Commercially minded

Comfortable making decisions

Able to work independently

Strong at research and problem solving

Comfortable learning unfamiliar industries

Extremely organized

An excellent English communicator

Comfortable working directly with a fast-moving U.S.-based entrepreneur

We value business judgment and resourcefulness more than credentials or corporate titles.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This is a VA role, but it is not primarily about calendar management, data entry, or routine administrative work.

We are looking for someone who understands businesses.

The long-term opportunity is to become the founder's right hand in researching, launching, and operating new ventures.

For the right person, that could eventually mean taking significant ownership over the operations of one or more businesses.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include both of the following.

1. Resume / CV - Provide a link to your updated resume.

2. Introduction Video - Record a short video introducing yourself and tell us about one U.S.-based business you worked closely with and understood particularly well.

Please explain:

-What the business did

-Who its customers were

-How the business made money

-Your role in the company

-Which areas of the business you personally worked on

-How customers were acquired

-How the product or service was delivered

-How the team was structured

-One significant operational problem you encountered and how you helped solve it

-One thing you would do differently if you were building that business from scratch today

Please do not simply read your resume.

We want to hear you explain the business in your own words. The purpose of the video is to understand how deeply you were involved in the business and whether you understand how all the pieces worked together.



If you have spent years working closely with entrepreneurs and have thought, “I understand how this business works well enough that I could help build one myself,” we would like to hear from you.

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

Previous experience in Sales, Forex, CFD’s, Futures, Financial Services, or Proprietary Trading is highly preferred.





ABOUT US

We are Upcomers, one of the fastest growing proprietary trading firms in the world. We operate in a fast moving, highly competitive market.





Role Details:

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time (Flexible hours, including possible weekends)

• Rate: $4 - $5 USD per hour





Key Responsibilities:

• Engage with prospective traders through chat, email, calls, and other communication channels.

• Explain our prop firm's trading challenges, account options, rules, pricing, and benefits clearly and accurately.

• Convert qualified leads into paying clients while maintaining a professional and consultative approach.

What we're looking for:

• Confident communication and negotiation skills.

• Comfortable speaking with traders through calls and live chat.

• Strong follow-up and closing skills.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱100,000–₱115,000/month + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



•5+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 2 years building AI/LLM systems used by real users or clients

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)
description:
Company: Samba Soccer Schools Global Ltd



Location: Remote – Philippines



Salary: $800 USD per month



Working Days: Monday–Friday



Working Hours: 6:00am–3:00pm UK time (2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time), including a 1-hour break.



Position: Full-time, long-term, exclusive — we will be your only client.



ABOUT SAMBA SOCCER SCHOOLS



Samba Soccer Schools is a growing UK-based children's football coaching organisation. We have coached over 20,000 children across London in the last 15 years, and we are now expanding across the UK through both our company-owned operating business and a network of independently operated franchise businesses.



As our franchise network continues to expand, we are looking for an experienced, proactive and commercially minded finance professional to join our team.



This person will be responsible for supporting the financial operations of both our main operating business and our franchise network, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, effective financial management, consistent reporting and strong financial performance.



You will work closely with the Managing Director, our UK accountants and individual franchise partners.



This is not simply a bookkeeping or data-entry position.



We want someone who understands how businesses operate financially, can interpret financial information, identify problems early, recommend improvements and help franchise partners become more financially successful.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. MAIN OPERATING BUSINESS – FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT



You will help manage the day-to-day financial operations of Samba Soccer Schools' main operating business.



Responsibilities include:



Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records using Xero.



Completing monthly bank reconciliations.



Monitoring revenue, expenditure, invoices and supplier payments.



Tracking accounts payable and receivable.



Monitoring company cash flow and preparing forecasts.



Reviewing monthly profit and loss statements.



Tracking budgets and identifying overspending.



Monitoring recurring costs, subscriptions and supplier expenses.



Identifying cost-saving opportunities.



Preparing weekly and monthly financial summaries for the Managing Director.



Working with our external UK accountants to ensure accurate financial records and compliance, including preparing the workings for VAT returns for their review.



2. FRANCHISE NETWORK – MONTHLY BOOKKEEPING



You will also be responsible for managing and coordinating the monthly bookkeeping requirements across our growing network of franchise businesses.



Responsibilities include:



Maintaining bookkeeping records for individual franchisees using Xero.



Completing monthly bank reconciliations for franchise businesses.



Ensuring income and expenditure are correctly categorised.



Reviewing transactions and investigating discrepancies.



Monitoring outstanding invoices and financial commitments.



Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and on time each month.



Maintaining consistent charts of accounts across franchise businesses.



Working with our external accountants to ensure records are accurate and ready for statutory and tax reporting.



Each franchise must have accurate, organised and up-to-date financial information.



3. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL ONBOARDING



When new franchise partners join Samba Soccer Schools, you will take responsibility for supporting the financial onboarding process.



This includes:



Guiding franchisees through the financial setup of their businesses.



Coordinating the setup and configuration of Xero.



Ensuring the correct chart of accounts is implemented.



Supporting the setup of bank feeds and accounting processes.



Explaining how franchisees should manage income, expenditure and financial records.



Educating new franchisees on bookkeeping responsibilities and financial procedures.



Ensuring each franchise follows our standardised reporting structure.



Liaising with franchisees and accountants to resolve financial setup issues.



Our goal is for every franchise partner to start their business with the correct financial systems, processes and understanding in place.



4. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE MONITORING



A major part of this role involves actively monitoring the financial performance of our franchise network.



You will:



Review monthly revenue, operating costs and profitability for each franchise.



Monitor profit margins and overall financial health.



Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.



Identify franchisees experiencing financial difficulties.



Monitor trends in revenue, expenses and profitability.



Analyse venue-level profitability where data is available.



Identify unnecessary costs and opportunities to improve financial performance.



Track outstanding franchise fees, royalties and other financial obligations.



Produce meaningful financial insights and recommendations.



We want someone who can look at financial reports and explain what the numbers mean, why performance is changing and what action should be taken.



5. MONTHLY FRANCHISE FINANCIAL REPORTING



You will be responsible for preparing and distributing monthly financial performance reports to franchise partners.



Each report should provide a clear overview of the franchise's financial performance, including:



Monthly revenue.



Operating expenditure.



Gross and net profitability.



Profit margins.



Cash-flow position.



Performance against budgets or previous periods.



Significant changes in income or expenditure.



Areas of financial concern.



Recommendations to improve profitability.



Reports must be accurate, easy to understand and consistent across the franchise network.



You will also provide the Managing Director with a consolidated overview of franchise financial performance.



6. FINANCIAL EDUCATION & FRANCHISE SUPPORT



We want our franchise partners to become financially knowledgeable and capable business owners.



You will play an important role in developing their financial understanding and commercial awareness.



Responsibilities include:



Helping franchisees understand their profit and loss statements.



Explaining the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.



Educating franchisees on budgeting and financial planning.



Helping franchisees understand their operating costs and profit margins.



Explaining how to identify unnecessary expenditure.



Supporting franchisees with financial questions.



Helping franchisees understand how financial decisions affect profitability.



Providing practical recommendations to improve business performance.



You must be confident explaining financial concepts in simple, clear English to people who may not have an accounting background.



7. EARLY IDENTIFICATION OF FINANCIAL PROBLEMS



One of the most important responsibilities of this position is identifying financial problems before they become serious.



You will be expected to proactively monitor the finances of both our operating business and franchise network.



Examples include:



A franchise consistently operating at a loss.



Rapidly increasing operating costs.



Significant reductions in revenue.



Poor cash-flow management.



Unpaid invoices or overdue financial obligations.



Unusual transactions or financial discrepancies.



Potential cash shortages.



Franchisees spending beyond their available budgets.



Unexpected changes in profitability.



Any significant financial concern must be flagged directly to the Managing Director as early as possible, together with an explanation of the issue and recommended actions.



We do not want someone who simply reports financial problems after they have happened.



We want someone proactive who can anticipate risks and help prevent them.



8. FINANCIAL REPORTING & MANAGEMENT DASHBOARDS



You will also help develop and maintain financial reporting systems for the wider business.



This includes:



Preparing monthly management accounts.



Maintaining cash-flow forecasts.



Creating Excel or Google Sheets financial dashboards.



Monitoring key financial performance indicators.



Producing weekly financial summaries for management.



Comparing performance across franchise businesses.



Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.



Supporting the Managing Director with financial analysis and business decisions.



We are an AI-forward business: we use modern AI tools throughout our financial workflows, and we will train you on our systems. An interest in working this way is important.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Minimum 2–3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.



Previous experience supporting UK businesses, including familiarity with UK VAT and UK accounting practices.



Strong hands-on experience using Xero.



Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients.



Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.



Experience with bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.



Good understanding of budgeting, profitability and cash-flow management.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Excellent attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



Accounting qualification (CPA) or relevant university degree.



Experience at an outsourcing/BPO firm serving UK accounting practices.



Experience working with franchise businesses or multi-location companies.



Experience preparing management accounts and financial dashboards.



Experience supporting business owners with financial planning.



Experience training or explaining financial concepts to non-finance professionals.



THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organised, reliable and trustworthy.



Confident working with financial information.



Proactive rather than reactive.



Commercially minded and interested in business performance.



Comfortable communicating directly with business owners.



Able to explain complicated financial information simply.



Confident identifying problems and recommending solutions.



Capable of managing multiple businesses and deadlines.



Interested in building a long-term career with our company.



We value initiative, ownership and accountability.



If you notice a problem, we want you to raise it.



If you identify an opportunity to improve profitability, we want you to recommend it.



If a franchise partner is struggling financially, we want you to help them understand why and what they can do about it.



WHAT WE OFFER



$800 USD monthly salary, paid monthly via Wise.



Salary reviews after 6 and 12 months, based on performance.



Consistent full-time Monday–Friday schedule on a standard Philippine mid shift (2:00pm–11:00pm).



Long-term opportunity with a growing UK company.



Direct working relationship with the Managing Director.



Opportunity to work across multiple businesses.



Exposure to franchise operations and business financial management.



Clear potential for career progression as the franchise network grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:



1. How many years of bookkeeping or accounting experience do you have?



2. How many years have you used Xero professionally?



3. Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients simultaneously?



4. Describe your experience working with UK-based businesses, including any UK VAT work.



5. Can you independently prepare monthly management accounts, profit and loss statements and cash-flow forecasts?



6. Have you ever monitored the financial performance of a business and recommended improvements? Give a brief example.



7. Are you comfortable explaining financial reports to business owners who do not have an accounting background?



8. Have you supported the financial onboarding or accounting setup of new businesses?



9. This is a full-time, exclusive role. Are you able to commit 100% of your working time to us, with no other clients?



10. Are you available to work 2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time (6:00am–3:00pm UK time), Monday–Friday?



11. Are you happy with the salary of $800 USD per month pay?



12. When would you be available to start?



Please attach your CV and, if possible, an anonymised example of a financial report or dashboard you have previously prepared.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "SAMBA FINANCE" so we know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online interview and a paid practical finance assessment using real (anonymised) company data.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Virtual Assistant, QBO Bookkeeper (Gig Work)
description:
About the Position

I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant with at least 2 years of hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online to manage bookkeeping for a small real estate investment portfolio.

This is a part-time, ongoing gig position. Initially, anticipate approximately 2 hours of work per day. Once the books are cleaned up and caught up, the workload should decrease to approximately 1 hour per day.

I am looking for someone who is organized, trustworthy, communicates well, and takes ownership of their work.



Job Responsibilities

1. QuickBooks Online Bookkeeping

Maintain and update the company's books using QuickBooks Online.

Categorize income and expenses accurately.

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts.

Review transactions for accuracy and proper classification.

Identify duplicate, uncategorized, or incorrectly categorized transactions.

Maintain accurate financial records for a small real estate portfolio.

Assist with monthly bookkeeping and financial reporting.



2. Initial Bookkeeping Cleanup

The QuickBooks accounts have accumulated a number of dormant and inactive accounts over time.

Your initial responsibilities will include:

Reviewing the existing chart of accounts.

Identifying dormant, duplicate, or unnecessary accounts.

Recommending which accounts should be consolidated, deactivated, or retained.

Cleaning up transaction classifications where appropriate.

Organizing the books so they are easier to maintain going forward.

You must be comfortable working with an existing set of books that needs organization and cleanup.



3. Communication and Reporting

Provide a brief daily report outlining the work completed, hours worked, and any outstanding issues.

Participate in a weekly one hour meeting with the owner to review progress, discuss questions, and establish priorities.

Communicate promptly when something is unclear or requires approval.

Flag discrepancies, unusual transactions, and potential bookkeeping problems rather than making assumptions.



Hours and Compensation

Pay: $6 USD per hour.

Initial workload: Approximately 2 hours per day.

Expected ongoing workload: Approximately 1 hour per day after the initial cleanup.

Weekly meeting: One hour with the owner.

Long-term opportunity for the right person.

Hours may vary depending on workload and the stage of the cleanup.



Time Tracking and Payment

Payment will be sent through Sendwave.

A time-tracking application will be required to record working hours and provide visibility into work activity.

Accurate time tracking is mandatory.

Daily activity reports are required.



Required Qualifications

Applicants MUST meet the following requirements:

At least 2 years of professional experience with QuickBooks Online.

Real Estate Bookkeeping experience is preferrred

Strong understanding of bookkeeping fundamentals.

Experience categorizing transactions and reconciling bank accounts.

Experience reviewing and cleaning up existing QuickBooks accounts.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Good written and spoken English.

Reliable internet connection.

Ability to attend a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

Comfortable working independently and providing daily progress reports.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit an application that includes ALL of the following:

Your QuickBooks Experience: Briefly describe your bookkeeping experience and how many years you have worked with QuickBooks Online.

Bonus points if you have leasing experience

Resume: Include a link to your current resume (Google Drive or another accessible link).

QuickBooks Experience: Describe your experience reconciling bank accounts, categorizing transactions, and cleaning up an existing QuickBooks company file.

Availability: Confirm that you can initially work approximately 2 hours per day and participate in a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

Internet Connection: Confirm that you have a reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for bookkeeping work.

Favorite Filipino Celebrity: Include a photo of your favorite famous person from the Philippines. This is simply a fun way for me to get to know a little about you and also helps me confirm that applicants have read the entire job posting.

title: Rental Booking Host
description:
CAR RENTAL OPERATIONS, INVOICING & GHL ASSISTANT



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Work Days: Thursday–Monday

Days Off: Tuesday & Wednesday

Schedule: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time

Starting Pay: $300 USD/month — approximately ₱18,800 PHP/month

PHP equivalent will vary based on the exchange rate.



Philippine Schedule



Your working schedule is always based on Texas/U.S. Central Time.



While Texas is observing Daylight Saving Time:



9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time = approximately 10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine Time



When Texas returns to Standard Time:



9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time = approximately 11:00 PM–8:00 AM Philippine Time



The Philippines does not change clocks, but Texas does, so your Philippine working hours will change during the year.



Your regular days off are:



TUESDAY & WEDNESDAY



Please make sure this schedule works for you before applying.



⸻

 PLEASE READ THE PAY BEFORE APPLYING

This position starts at:



$300 USD PER MONTH



If you are currently looking for a higher starting salary, please do not apply.



We want to be respectful of your time and ours.



This opportunity is designed for someone who wants to:



LEARN • PROVE THEMSELVES • GROW • TAKE OWNERSHIP • BUILD A LONG-TERM POSITION



We are willing to train the right person.



You may have previous experience, but you will still need to learn our company, our procedures, our rental policies, our systems, our customers, and the way we operate.



Compensation increases are not automatic or guaranteed.



Growth is based on your:



Reliability • Performance • Accuracy • Responsibility • Communication • Leadership • Knowledge • Business Needs



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a bigger role — not someone looking for a temporary position while searching for their next job.



⸻



WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

You will help us manage the daily operations of a growing U.S.-based car-rental company.



This is not a position where you simply wait for someone to give you random administrative tasks.



You will gradually be trained to help us control the rental operation.



That means knowing:



* Who is renting each vehicle

* Who has paid

* Who has not paid

* What each renter owes

* Which invoices are outstanding

* Which leads need follow-up

* Which customers need to be contacted

* What happened during previous conversations

* What information needs to be documented

* What needs management attention



We need someone who learns the business well enough to notice when something is wrong.



⸻



CUSTOMER SERVICE & RENTAL BOOKINGS

You may be responsible for:



* Answering incoming customer calls

* Returning missed calls

* Responding to text messages

* Speaking with prospective renters

* Explaining rental requirements

* Answering common rental questions

* Following up with interested leads

* Helping qualified customers move through the rental process

* Scheduling appointments

* Booking vehicle pickups

* Following up with customers who have not completed the process

* Updating renter information

* Documenting conversations

* Keeping customer records organized



You must be comfortable actually talking to people.



This is not a text-only position.



⸻



YOUR PHONE VOICE MATTERS — A LOT

You will regularly communicate with U.S.-based customers.



Your English must be:



CLEAR • NATURAL • CONFIDENT • FRIENDLY • PROFESSIONAL



You do not need to sound American.



You do need to be easy to understand and comfortable communicating professionally.



You must be willing to:



* Make outgoing calls

* Receive incoming calls

* Follow up with leads

* Speak with renters about money

* Remain professional when customers are frustrated

* Ask direct questions when necessary

* Communicate confidently without sounding rude or robotic



If you are extremely uncomfortable speaking on the phone, this position is probably not a good fit.



⸻



 DAILY RENTAL PAYMENT CONTROL



This is one of the most important responsibilities in the position.



Our rental customers may make payments seven days per week.



You will be trained to help monitor renter accounts and make sure our records stay accurate.



This may include:



* Checking renter payments

* Reviewing payment screenshots or confirmations

* Confirming manual payments have been properly recorded

* Identifying unpaid or partially paid accounts

* Reviewing outstanding balances

* Creating invoices

* Updating invoices

* Recording payments

* Maintaining renter payment ledgers

* Checking that required invoices were sent

* Sending professional payment reminders

* Calling or texting renters with missed payments

* Documenting promises to pay

* Updating account notes

* Flagging accounts that are becoming delinquent

* Escalating serious payment issues to management



We do not want someone who sees an unpaid account and simply leaves it there.



We need someone who notices it, documents it, follows the procedure, and communicates what is happening.



⸻



NIGHTLY PAYMENT CHECK

Our renter payment deadline is later than the regular daytime office schedule.



Because of this, on working days you may be responsible for a brief payment-control check around 9:15 PM U.S. Central Time.



This is separate from sitting online and working continuously all evening.



The purpose is to verify things such as:



* Who paid

* Who did not pay

* Which accounts require follow-up

* Whether payments were recorded correctly

* Whether an invoice or ledger needs to be updated

* Whether management needs to be notified



This is a car-rental operation. Payments and renters do not always operate on a perfect 9-to-5 schedule.



You must be reasonably comfortable with that reality.



⸻



 GOHIGHLEVEL — GHL



GoHighLevel is an important part of our operation.



You may be trained to:



* Update contacts

* Update customer records

* Update opportunities

* Move leads through pipeline stages

* Create tasks

* Schedule appointments

* Review conversations

* Send messages

* Update notes

* Help organize pipelines

* Monitor workflows

* Assist with automations

* Test automations

* Identify when an automation did not work correctly

* Help maintain customer follow-up systems



Previous GoHighLevel experience is helpful, but it is not required if you are highly trainable.



However, you must be comfortable learning software.



⸻



 INVOICING, RECORDS & BOOKKEEPING SUPPORT



You may also help maintain the administrative and financial records connected to our rental operation.



Tasks may include:



* Creating rental invoices

* Updating invoices

* Recording payments

* Maintaining renter ledgers

* Reviewing customer balances

* Organizing supporting documents

* Uploading financial records

* Helping organize payroll documents

* Uploading or organizing tax/payroll forms such as Form 941

* Organizing financial statements

* Assisting with bookkeeping-related administrative work

* Checking records for missing information

* Keeping company files organized



You are not expected to arrive knowing everything.



You are expected to learn.



⸻



WE CARE A LOT ABOUT MEMORY & RETENTION



We will train you.

But training does not mean your manager should have to teach the same process from the beginning every time you perform it.



We strongly prefer someone who:



* Takes detailed notes during training

* Creates their own checklists

* Reviews previous training

* Uses recorded training materials

* Remembers corrections

* Learns from mistakes

* Looks for the answer before immediately asking again

* Follows established procedures

* Can work independently after being trained

* Notices inconsistencies

* Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities



If we teach you something Thursday and you do not perform that task again until Monday, we expect you to review your training materials and notes before saying:



“I don’t remember.”



We want someone resourceful.



⸻



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO PAYS ATTENTION

A strong candidate does not only complete tasks.



They notice things.



For example:



If a renter normally pays daily and suddenly has not paid, you notice.



If an invoice amount does not match the renter ledger, you notice.



If someone promised to pay yesterday and still has not paid, you notice.



If a customer has called several times and nobody followed up, you notice.



If an automation should have sent something and did not, you notice.



If information is missing from an account, you notice.



That level of awareness is extremely valuable to us.



⸻



REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

Because this is a remote position, you must be dependable without someone physically standing over you.



You should have:



* Reliable internet

* A dependable computer

* A quiet enough environment for professional customer calls

* Reliable electricity or a reasonable backup plan

* The ability to communicate with the team throughout your shift



You should also be comfortable using:



* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

*

* Messaging platforms

* CRM software

* Online invoicing systems

* Cloud-based business tools



⸻



OUR TEAM ENVIRONMENT

We work hard, but we are also human.



We laugh.



We joke.



We talk.



We ask questions.



We help each other.



We communicate throughout the day while getting the work done.



We want someone who is comfortable:



* Communicating with coworkers

* Participating in team conversations

* Asking thoughtful questions

* Helping teammates

* Receiving feedback

* Being corrected professionally

* Correcting mistakes

* Building positive working relationships



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect effort, honesty, accountability, improvement, and communication.



⸻



OCCASIONAL URGENT SITUATIONS



Car rentals sometimes involve situations that cannot conveniently wait until the next morning.



Examples could include:



* A renter with an urgent vehicle issue

* A payment problem

* A vehicle return issue

* An account requiring immediate escalation

* A serious customer situation



This does not mean you will constantly work outside your scheduled hours.



It does mean we need someone who understands this is an operations position and is reasonably willing to assist with a true urgent situation when necessary.



As your responsibility within the company grows, your role and compensation may grow with it.



If you require a position where you can never be contacted outside your working hours under any circumstances, this may not be the right opportunity.



⸻



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE LONG-TERM

We do not want to continuously train a new person every few months.



We want to find someone we can:



TRAIN • TRUST • DEVELOP • KEEP



Someone who eventually knows our operation extremely well.



Someone who becomes valuable because they understand:



Our customers.

Our vehicles.

Our payments.

Our systems.

Our procedures.

Our team.



If you are looking for somewhere you can learn, become more valuable, take on greater responsibility, and potentially grow with a company over time, we would like to hear from you.



⸻



 90-DAY PROBATIONARY PERIOD



All new hires begin with a 90-day probationary period.



During this period, we evaluate:



Attendance

Reliability

Communication

Phone Skills

English Communication

Memory & Retention

Learning Ability

Accuracy

Productivity

Work Quality

Initiative

Following Procedures

Problem Solving

Professionalism

Teamwork

Accountability

Overall Fit



Successful completion of probation is required before becoming a permanent long-term contractor.



⸻



 REQUIRED VIDEO INTRODUCTION

IF YOU DO NOT SUBMIT THE VIDEO, YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Your video is part of your interview.



Please answer ALL 17 QUESTIONS.



1.



Tell us about yourself and your previous work experience.



2.



Why are you looking for a long-term position?



3.



What is the longest you have stayed with one employer or client, and why did you leave?



4.



Are you currently employed, freelancing, or working for other clients?



Please be honest.



5.



If hired, will this be your only full-time job?



If not, explain your other work commitments and schedule.



6.



Are you comfortable making and receiving phone calls with U.S.-based customers?

7.



Tell us about a time you were responsible for something important without your manager constantly watching you.



What were you responsible for, and how did you make sure it was completed correctly?



8.



When someone trains you on a new process, what do you personally do to make sure you remember it?



9.



Imagine we train you on a task Thursday, but you do not need to perform that task again until Monday.



When Monday comes, you cannot remember every step.



What would you do?



10.



Tell us about something complicated you had to learn at a previous job.



How did you learn it, document it, and remember how to do it?



11.



Tell us about a mistake you made at work.



What happened, how did you handle it, and what did you do to prevent it from happening again?



12.



When working remotely, do you enjoy communicating and interacting with coworkers, or do you prefer working mostly independently?



Describe your personality at work.



13.



Our team works hard, but we also laugh, joke, communicate, ask questions, and interact throughout the day.



Would you enjoy being part of that kind of team? Why?



14.



Can you consistently work:



THURSDAY–MONDAY



9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. CENTRAL TIME



with Tuesday and Wednesday OFF?



Please confirm that you understand these hours will be overnight hours in the Philippines.



15.



Our rental payment deadline occurs later in the evening.



On your scheduled working days, are you willing and able to perform a brief payment-control check around 9:15 PM U.S. Central Time when required?



Please explain any limitations.



16.



This is a car-rental operation, so occasionally a true urgent renter, vehicle, or payment issue may happen outside regular working hours.



Are you reasonably willing to respond to an occasional urgent situation?



Please explain any limitations you would have.



17.



This position starts at:



$300 USD PER MONTH



Regardless of previous experience, every new person must learn our company’s systems and procedures.



Do you accept the $300 USD/month starting compensation, and do you understand that increases are not automatic or guaranteed but depend on performance, responsibility, business needs, and your growth within the company?



Please explain your understanding in your own words.



⸻



MAGIC WORD

To prove that you read this entire job posting, the FIRST LINE of your application must say:



CHEESE OMELETT



If CHEESE OMELETT is not the first line of your application, your application will not be considered.



⸻



 HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:

* Your current resume

* Confirmation that you accept the $300 USD/month starting compensation

* Confirmation that you can work Thursday–Monday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time

* Confirmation that you understand Tuesday and Wednesday are your regular days off

* Confirmation that you understand the brief evening payment-check responsibility

* Confirmation that you understand the occasional urgent-situation expectation



Incomplete applications may not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone we can:



TRAIN • TRUST • DEVELOP • KEEP LONG-TERM



If you are dependable, friendly, highly trainable, comfortable speaking with customers, good at remembering processes, willing to take ownership, and excited about growing with a company, we would love to review your application.

title: Pharmacy Compliance Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW 



Job Location: Remote 



Job Type: Full-Time | Remote 



Department: Compliance 



Reports To: Director of Compliance 



Shift: 9AM to 5:30 PM (EST) 



Direct Report(s): Yes 



 



OVERVIEW 



Reporting to the Director of Compliance and working directly with the VP of Compliance, the Pharmacy Compliance Manager will help shape the compliance database alongside IT and put the pharmacy process plan into action as each pharmacy goes live, partnering directly with pharmacies, Operations, and Covered Entities. The role starts hands on, working the data firsthand, and grows into leading and developing a team of Pharmacy Compliance Analysts. It suits someone who enjoys turning raw dispense data into information that auditors and partners can trust. 



 



RESPONSIBILITIES 



1. Team Leadership and Analyst Development 



Perform the full scope of Pharmacy Compliance Analyst work while the team is being established, and transition work to analysts as they are hired. 



Train new Pharmacy Compliance Analysts on pharmacy data, the compliance database, reconciliation, monthly audits, and the pharmacy process plan, and document procedures for consistent onboarding. 



Oversee analysts' assignments, pharmacy coverage, quality, and progress, and resolve escalated discrepancies. 



Set goals and expectations for each analyst, hold regular one on one meetings, and provide coaching and performance feedback. 



Support analyst work as the team expands, including during pharmacy go lives, and partner with the Director of Compliance on hiring needs. 



2. Data Review and Reconciliation 



Analyze pharmacy purchasing, dispensing, and eligibility data to identify and resolve discrepancies and promote program compliance. 



Reconcile dispenses against virtual inventory, purchase orders, and quantities ordered. 



Validate NDC, package size, and billing unit accuracy across each dispense. 



Consult EMRs to confirm patient eligibility where the data alone cannot establish it. 



3. Reporting and Database Integrity 



Maintain critical data and tables within the compliance database, partnering with internal departments and external stakeholders. 



Prepare and validate system generated reports, and review reporting prepared by the Compliance team before it is released. 



Develop and maintain Excel workbooks, Power Query, and SQL queries that pull, reconcile, and verify pharmacy data. 



Identify data issues and partner with IT and other internal departments to resolve them. 



Preserve copies of reports and supporting data to support audit readiness. 



4. Audits and Compliance Monitoring 



Execute monthly audits for each assigned pharmacy, ensuring compliance with stakeholder requirements, and review audits completed by analysts. 



Monitor payor and eligibility data for compliance risk, escalating findings promptly. 



Support internal and external audit preparation with thorough, traceable documentation. 



Help safeguard systems against duplicate discounts and diversion. 



5. Process Development and Onboarding 



Work with the VP and Director of Compliance to support IT in building out the pharmacy compliance database. 



Execute and refine the pharmacy process plan with the Director of Compliance, making adjustments as needed. 



Work directly with pharmacies, the pharmacy liaisons on the Operations team, and Covered Entities as necessary to set up appropriate report receipt, ask clarifying questions, and document program parameters. 



Support the onboarding and reconciliation of each pharmacy as it goes live. 



Understand how pharmacy data flows in and out of the compliance database, including to auditors and other parties that require it. 



Participate in user acceptance testing to ensure compliance solutions meet business needs and regulatory requirements. 



 



QUALIFICATIONS 



Bachelor's degree in pharmacy, healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related analytical field. 



Minimum of 4 years of experience in a pharmacy setting with direct 340B program exposure, or equivalent experience within a 340B third party administrator or pharmacy inventory analysis focused role. 



Working knowledge of pharmacy and medication data, including NDCs, package sizes, dispensed quantities, and billing units, with the ability to confirm that dispensed amounts align with quantities ordered. 



Proficiency in Power Query for secure access to compliance database information, with advanced Excel skills. 



Excellent analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking abilities with a keen eye for detail and data integrity. 



Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 



Demonstrated ability to work independently while a team is being built, and to train, coach, and oversee the work of others. 



Preferred Qualifications 



Experience with how pharmacy data flows for auditors and other parties that require it. 



SQL experience for querying databases.

title: Senior KYC/KYB Analyst
description:
About Us



We are an international company working with a remote team in the Philippines since 2008. We value professionalism, collaboration, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced global environment. Our team thrives on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we’re looking for someone who shares these values.



About You

We are looking for a highly accurate, detail-oriented, and analytical KYC/KYB Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and KYB checks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting our onboarding and verification processes. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, works with integrity, and is comfortable handling sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own end-to-end KYC and KYB reviews for individual and corporate customers, from onboarding through approval, rejection, or escalation.

- Review and verify identity documents, proof of address, company registration documents, and complex ownership and control structures, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and controllers.

- Carry out Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk customers, including PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, complex or opaque structures, crypto/Web3 businesses and unusual activity profiles.

- Assess and evidence source of funds and source of wealth, and challenge customers where the explanation or documents are inconsistent or insufficient.

- Perform AML screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), resolve potential matches and document a clear rationale for each decision.

- Complete customer risk assessments, assign risk ratings, and recommend approval, conditional approval, or rejection for complex and high-risk cases.

- Escalate suspicious activity and red flags to the Head of Compliance, with well-documented case summaries to support any internal suspicious activity report.

- Run periodic reviews and re-verification based on customer risk level, including trigger-based reviews when ownership, activity, or risk profile changes.

- Manage verification workflows in Sumsub (or similar KYC/AML tools), including configuring checks, resolving system issues, and flagging improvements.

- Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from banking and payment partners, preparing clear, complete case files within agreed timelines

- Work with Support, Business, Product and Tech teams across multiple business units to resolve discrepancies, chase outstanding information and unblock stuck cases.

- Contribute to improving KYC/KYB procedures, checklists and risk-assessment frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and partner expectations.

- Keep accurate, audit-ready records for every check and decision.

- Handle confidential and sensitive customer data with discretion, in line with data protection requirements.



REQUIREMENTS:

1–3 years of proven, hands-on experience in KYC and KYB verification, with a strong focus on reviewing and validating KYB documentation

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to efficiently identify inconsistencies, risks, and missing information

- Proven experience following and adhering to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines

- Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar AML/KYC tools (e.g., Veriff, Onfido, Persona, ComplyAdvantage)

- Solid understanding of AML, KYC, and compliance processes, particularly in a B2B context

- Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

- Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively

- Availability: Must be available and responsive during the agreed 8-hour shift

- Good Internet Connection: Reliable and stable for remote work

- Must have a Wise account or reside in a location that supports Wise

title: Online Cover Teacher for Neurodivergent Learners (On-Call / As-Needed)
description:
We are looking for a deeply compassionate, neurodiversity-affirming Cover Teacher to join our on-call pool. Our learners are neurodivergent (including students with ADHD, autism, and anxiety), so emotional safety, patience, and genuine understanding are at the heart of everything we do.



You will step in to lead online lessons occasionally when our regular teachers are away or unavailable. Because cover is only needed from time to time (not every day), there is no fixed timetable or guaranteed weekly hours. This makes the role ideal if you want flexible, rewarding extra teaching hours alongside other commitments. When a cover slot opens up, we will reach out, and if you are available to take it, you will be paid per lesson delivered.



Depending on who is away, you will step into one of two areas:



IGCSE Exam Preparation: Supporting neurodivergent learners through their IGCSE curriculum in Travel & Tourism, Business Studies, Environmental Management, or Mathematics at a pace that feels safe and manageable.



The Launchpad Programme: Leading gentle, low-pressure sessions focused on rebuilding self-esteem, reducing school-related anxiety, and nurturing a love of learning.



Must-Have Qualifications & Skills



Proven Neurodiversity Experience: Hands-on experience teaching, tutoring, or supporting neurodivergent learners (ADHD, autism, anxiety, etc.) with empathy and zero judgement.



Calm & Affirming Approach: A kind, patient, and low-stress teaching style with strong rapport-building skills. You prioritise connection and psychological safety before pushing academic output.



Adaptability: Ability to step into a session smoothly and flexibly adjust to a student's energy, sensory needs, or pace on the day.



Subject Knowledge: Strong command of IGCSE-level content in one or more of the listed subjects.



Communication & Tech: Clear spoken English, a stable internet connection, and a reliable home setup (webcam and microphone) with a quiet, distraction-free background.



Digital Fluency: Comfortable using Google Meet, Google Classroom, and simple online teaching tools.



Nice-to-Have



Familiarity with low-demand, student-led learning and trauma-informed practice.



Experience adapting resources for neurodivergent minds (e.g., visual supports, chunked tasks, clear instructions, and scaffolded worksheets).



Prior experience teaching Edexcel IGCSE or the UK curriculum.



Schedule & Pay



100% Flexible / On-Call: No fixed timetable; accept cover lessons only when they fit your schedule.



Pay-Per-Lesson: You are paid directly for each individual lesson you take on.



How to Apply

If you are passionate about neurodiversity-affirming education and know how to create a safe, encouraging space for learners to thrive, please apply with:



Your CV / Resume.



Which IGCSE subjects (Travel & Tourism, Business Studies, Environmental Management, Maths) you can cover.



A brief paragraph sharing your experience working with neurodivergent learners and what makes your teaching style a good fit for them.



Your general availability (days and times in UK time).

title: Claims QA Specialist
description:
Website: Pawpay

Location: Remote

Status: Full-time



Position Summary:



PawPay is seeking a detail-oriented team member to drive operational excellence across our claims ecosystem. This hybrid role bridges active claims processing and external stakeholder coordination with high-level quality auditing.







This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to build experience in healthcare administration, insurance operations, customer support, or claims processing.

Claims Management

Submit claims to insurance providers.

Maintain accurate tracking of claim statuses.

Maintain organized digital records within company systems.

Monitor claims, manage workflow queues, and ensure full compliance with SOPs and insurance regulations.





Stakeholder Communication



Act as a primary liaison with insurance carriers.

Execute and audit follow-ups across phone calls,
, and SMS  messaging.





Quality Assurance

title: Meta & Google Ads Specialist (Performance Media Buyer) — Run Our Ads, Then Our Clients' Ads
description:
Landing Nest Media is a fast-growing real estate media agency in New England. We shoot listing photos, video, drone, and floor plans for top real estate agents, and we produce short-form video for home-service brands like roofing companies. We are not looking for a beginner, a course graduate, or someone who has boosted a few posts. This role has two jobs, in this order:

1. Run Landing Nest Media's own ads and turn them into booked shoots and signed clients.

2. Once that is working, run ads for our clients, so ad management becomes a service we sell.



How the start works: your first 30 days are a test period on Landing Nest Media's own ads only. You prove you can produce booked calls at a cost that makes sense, on our account, with our money on the line. If you do well in those 30 days, we expand you onto client accounts, and each client account you take on adds its own per-account pay (see Pay and structure).



If you have only ever run ads for one small account with a tiny budget, this is not the role. If you have scaled local lead generation profitably and can show your work, keep reading.



About Landing Nest Media (read this before writing your 30-day plan)

- What we sell: media for real estate listings — photo, video, drone, and floor plan packages booked per shoot (our most-booked package is Essentials), plus monthly personal branding retainers for agents

- Our second line of business: short-form video content plans for home-service brands (roofing, junk removal, garage doors and similar trades), sold as monthly packages

- Who buys: real estate agents and brokerages, and home-service business owners

- Where: New England — Massachusetts, New Hampshire, southern Maine, Rhode Island, and Connecticut

- What makes us different: high-quality video, on-camera coaching for agents who are nervous on video, and fast delivery (photos and floor plan in 24 hours, video in 48 hours)

- Where ads fit: paid ads are the growth channel we are building now. Your job is to turn ad spend into booked shoots and signed retainer clients, tracked in our CRM (GoHighLevel) from click to booked call

- Research us before you apply: 
 
 on Instagram. Your 30-day plan should be written for THIS business, not a generic template



What you will do

- Build, launch, and manage Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns for Landing Nest Media: lead generation for real estate listing media and for home-service video clients

- Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns: search campaigns for high-intent local terms, and YouTube/Local Services where they fit

- Own the full funnel, not just the ad account: targeting, creative briefs, copy, landing pages, lead forms, and tracking from click to booked call

- Work with our in-house video team on ad creative. We produce short-form video for a living, so you will brief us on the hooks, angles, and formats you need, and we will shoot and edit them

- Set up and verify conversion tracking end to end: Meta Pixel / Conversions API, Google tag and conversions, GA4, and call/form tracking in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Manage budgets like it is your own money: test fast, kill losers quickly, scale winners, and report what changed and why

- Report weekly with real numbers: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per booked call, and what you are testing next. No vanity metrics, no screenshots of reach as a result

- Join a weekly check-in call with the owner and team to review the numbers, what you tested, and what is next. This call is a standing meeting, not optional

- As client work starts: run the same playbook for home-service and real estate clients, with clear per-client budgets, targets, and reporting. Client ad spend is always billed separately from your pay and from our fees

Pay and structure

How to apply — applications without these will not be reviewed

5. Your expected per-account monthly rate (the posted range is $300-$500/month per account), and your availability for meetings during US Eastern Time hours
