title: Sales Associate / Account Executive
description:
About Simple Apply

Simple Apply automates the job application grind so career coaches can focus on coaching. We pull fresh roles straight from company career pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and iCIMS (over 1 million jobs a week), match them to each client's resume, and submit 20 to 40 applications a day per client. Coaches run everything from one dashboard, and their clients get a confirmation for every application sent. We partner with coaches and coaching businesses of every size, from solo coaches to programs with hundreds of clients.



The role

You'll talk to career coaches who are stretched thin, juggling clients and looking for a way to get them more interviews without more hours. Your job is to understand how their practice runs, tell them honestly whether Simple Apply fits, and close the ones that do.



Our team sources leads on LinkedIn and books calls, but when the calendar is empty, you fill it yourself. We move fast. We'd rather you try something today and tell us what broke than wait a week for permission.



What you'll do

-Qualify leads and identify prospects who are a good fit for Simple Apply and disqualify those who don’t meet the target customer profile.

-Manage follow-ups for interested leads who aren’t ready to purchase, including scheduling future check-ins.

-Run discovery and demo calls with career coaches and coaching businesses from LinkedIn outreach, inbound leads and referrals

-Explain the platform exactly as it works: where jobs come from, daily application volume, what coaches see on their dashboard, and what stays on the coach's side

-Work your own pipeline when there are no calls: no-shows, stalled trials, unresponsive LinkedIn leads and cold-call follow-ups

-Own and track your sales pipeline, including qualified leads, booked calls, trials started, and report performance weekly.

Log every conversation, deal amount and next step in HubSpot the same day

-Hand closed coaches to Ops cleanly so onboarding starts without back-and-forth

-Feed back what you hear on calls (objections, confusion, lost reasons) to the ops teams



What we look for

-1+ year closing in a consultative B2B sale (SaaS, HR tech, recruiting, coaching or services)

-A track record with numbers: what you sold, deal size, close rate

-Excellent spoken and written English, and a calm, confident presence with US-based clients

-You learn the service deeply enough to answer how-it-works questions on the call, not after it

-You don't wait for leads. An empty calendar makes you go prospect on LinkedIn or pick up the phone

You'd rather lose a deal than over-promise

-Comfortable with Google Meet, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace and LinkedIn outreach tools



Nice to have

-You've sold to career coaches, recruiters or coaching businesses

-You've worked in career services or been through a tough job search yourself

-Familiarity with applicant tracking systems like Workday, Greenhouse or Lever

-Experience in a fast-growing startup

title: Turn Warm Crypto Intros Into Recurring Income - No Closing Required
description:
We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):

That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

description:

I'm looking for a reliable, long-term video editor to create simple 60–
 second 
 video ads.



**Most of the work is already automated.**



I have an automated scene-pulling tool where you simply paste the script, and it automatically searches for relevant footage and generates a folder of clips matched to different parts of the script.



### Your Responsibilities

- Use the automatically generated folder of clips to assemble the video according to the script and voiceover.

- **Use common sense:** If a recommended clip is bad, irrelevant, repetitive, or doesn't match the voiceover, search for a better clip and replace it yourself.

- The tool doesn't always find footage of my actual product. You'll need to insert relevant product footage, which I'll provide.

- Keep the editing natural, engaging, and suitable for
 advertising.

- Complete scripts (75 seconds maximum)

- Voiceovers

- Access to the automated scene-pulling workflow

- Automatically generated folders of relevant clips

- Product footage and references

**Pay: $5 per completed video.**



Since the automated tool handles most of the footage searching, I expect each video to take approximately 30 minutes.



You must be capable of completing **at least 2 videos per hour** while maintaining quality.



These are straightforward video edits, not complex animations or advanced motion graphics.



### Long-Term Opportunity



I'm looking for someone who can handle consistent, high-volume video orders. If you're fast, reliable, and produce good work, there will be ongoing projects.



**Please only apply if you:**

- Accept $5 per video.

- Can complete at least 2 videos per hour.

- Can independently identify and replace poor clips.

- Have experience editing short-form ads.

- Are available for consistent work.

title: Credit Repair Specialist (Remote)
description:
About us



Credit Vixen is a US based credit repair company in Killeen, Texas. We help clients remove inaccurate items from their credit reports and build stronger credit. We are growing and need one person to own our client files and daily operations.



The role



This is a full time, long term position for one person who can do three jobs well: credit repair specialist, operations manager, and project manager. You will run client files from signup to results, keep our systems organized, and report progress to the owner every week. We want someone who takes ownership and does not wait to be told what to do next.



How to apply



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Start your subject line with the words "Credit Ready" followed by your name.

2. Record a 2 minute video (Loom is fine) introducing yourself and describing a client file

you handled from start to finish.

3. Answer in writing: Which credit repair software have you used, and how many active

client files did you manage at one time?

4. Answer in writing: A credit bureau replies that a disputed item is verified. What do

you do next?

5. Attach your resume and tell us your expected monthly pay.



What you will do



Credit repair

* Onboard new clients and collect their documents and credit monitoring logins

* Review all three bureau reports and identify inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable items

* Build a dispute plan for each client and prepare dispute and validation letters

* Send each round on time and track bureau, creditor, and collector responses

* Update client files after every response and plan the next round



Client communication



* Answer client
s, texts, and portal messages within one business day

* Send clear monthly progress updates in plain English

* Run onboarding and check in calls when needed



Operations



* Keep the CRM clean, current, and accurate for every client

* Follow up on failed payments and missing documents

* Write and update step by step processes for everything you do

* Manage the shared inbox, calendar, and client portal



Project management



* Track every client file, round, and deadline in one place

* Send the owner a weekly report: active clients, rounds sent, results, items stuck, and what you need

* Spot problems early and bring a solution with them



What we are looking for



* 2 or more years of hands on credit repair experience with US clients

* Working knowledge of the FCRA, FDCPA, and CROA

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Experience managing many client files at once without supervision

* Experience building or improving processes, or leading a small team

* Honest and careful with sensitive client information

* Reliable computer, backup internet, and a quiet place to work



Tools (experience with any of these is a plus)



* Credit repair software: Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, Client Dispute Manager

* CRM and automation: GoHighLevel

* Credit monitoring: IdentityIQ, SmartCredit, MyScoreIQ

* Team tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Loom, and ClickUp, Asana, or Trello



Schedule



Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. You must be available for at least 4 hours during US business hours.



Pay



$800 to $1,200 USD per month, based on experience. Paid twice a month. Raises are based on performance.

title: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Designer (React, Tailwind, Framer)
description:
About Us



We’re an early-stage consumer wellness and meditation startup building a digital platform across web and iOS.



We’re a small team consisting of a founder and an experienced backend developer and PM. Our product is functional, but we’re looking to significantly improve the frontend experience, visual consistency, and overall polish of our website and application ahead of launch.



We’re looking for a frontend developer who combines strong technical skills with excellent visual design instincts. Someone who can take ownership of the frontend, improve existing interfaces, create visual assets, and help deliver a polished, premium consumer experience.



What You’ll Do



* Improve and maintain our existing website and application frontend.

* Redesign interfaces to create a cohesive, modern experience.

* Develop responsive, mobile-first interfaces with attention to detail.

* Improve and maintain our marketing website using Framer.

* Develop application interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS.

* Build reusable components and consistent design systems, including typography, spacing, and visual styles.

* Redesign and create icons, illustrations, graphics, backgrounds, and other visual assets.

* Improve navigation, onboarding, and overall user experience.

* Implement thoughtful animations, transitions, and interactions.

* Collaborate with our backend developer on APIs and integrations.

* Work within our existing codebase and proactively identify technical and design improvements.



Our Technology Stack



* Framer: Marketing website design and development.

* React: Frontend application development.

* Tailwind CSS: Styling and responsive layouts.

* Supabase: Backend, database, and authentication.

* Netlify: Hosting and deployment.

* GitHub: Source control and collaboration.



Experience with iOS development or mobile frameworks is a plus.



What We’re Looking For



* Strong experience with React and modern frontend development.

* Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and responsive design.

* Hands-on Framer experience.

* Excellent visual design instincts and UI/UX sensibility.

* Experience creating icons, illustrations, graphics, and digital assets.

* Ability to establish cohesive design systems across web and mobile.

* Experience building polished, consumer-facing applications.

* Familiarity with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools.

* Familiarity with APIs, Supabase, and frontend/backend integration.

* Comfortable with GitHub, branches, and pull requests.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

* A strong portfolio demonstrating actual development and visual design work.



Experience with wellness, meditation, health, or subscription-based applications is a plus.



Engagement



This is a freelance, project-based engagement with potential for ongoing work.



We’ll start with a focused frontend improvement project covering the highest-priority areas of our website and application. If it’s a good fit, we’d like to maintain an ongoing relationship for future development, visual improvements, and new features.



You’ll work directly with the founder and backend developer. We’re a small, lean team that values initiative, clear communication, and high-quality execution over unnecessary meetings.



How to Apply

7. Short video introduction (required): Please submit a 2–3 minute Loom or screen-recorded video introducing yourself, walking us through one project you’ve personally developed, and explaining what you contributed. We’d also like to hear briefly how you would approach improving the frontend and visual design of an existing application.



Important: We’re looking for hands-on developers with demonstrated technical and visual design ability, not agencies or generic proposals. Applications must include relevant portfolio examples and evidence of actual development experience.

title: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and YouTube Ads.
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION: PAID MEDIA ADVERTISING SPECIALIST

**Experienced Professionals Only – No Beginners**



### IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are looking for a highly experienced Paid Media Advertising Specialist with proven, hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.



**We are NOT hiring beginners, trainees, or people who are simply familiar with advertising.**



We do not want someone who has only watched tutorials, completed online courses, or learned advertising from reading scripts. We need a professional who has personally created, managed, monitored, and optimized real advertising campaigns.



You must know what you are doing without needing someone to teach you the basics.



### REQUIRED ADVERTISING EXPERIENCE



Applicants MUST have actual working experience with the following advertising platforms:



1. **Google Ads** – Search campaigns, Display campaigns, YouTube campaigns, keyword research, conversion tracking, bidding strategies, and campaign optimization.

2. **Meta Ads Manager** –
 and Instagram paid advertising, audience targeting, retargeting, campaign setup, and optimization.

3. **TikTok Ads Manager** – TikTok paid advertising, campaign creation, audience targeting, and performance optimization.

4. **YouTube Ads** – Video advertising, audience targeting, campaign management, and conversion tracking.



Experience with all four platforms is required.



### JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



- Independently create and manage advertising campaigns.

- Develop effective paid advertising strategies.

- Research and identify profitable target audiences.

- Set up and manage advertising budgets.

- Monitor campaign performance and optimize results.

- Analyze clicks, impressions, conversions, cost per lead, and return on ad spend (ROAS).

- Develop retargeting campaigns.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and make necessary adjustments.

- Provide detailed weekly reports.

- Recommend strategies to improve advertising performance and reduce wasted spending.



### STRICT EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



- Minimum 3 years of professional, hands-on paid advertising experience.

- Must have personally managed real advertising campaigns.

- Must understand the technical side of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Must be able to explain campaign structures, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, audience targeting, and optimization.

- Must be comfortable answering technical questions during the interview.

- Must be able to demonstrate previous campaign results.



### IMPORTANT: OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



We will conduct technical interviews to evaluate your actual knowledge and experience.



Applicants will be asked specific questions about Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and YouTube Ads.



We expect you to answer questions based on your actual experience, not memorized scripts.



**Please do not apply if you do not have the required experience.**



We are not interested in hiring someone who will read prepared answers, pretend to understand advertising, or rely on AI-generated responses during the interview.



We will ask practical questions to determine whether you genuinely understand how to build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize advertising campaigns.



### HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of actual paid advertising experience do you have?

2. Which of the four advertising platforms have you personally managed?

3. What monthly advertising budgets have you managed?

4. Provide examples of campaigns you have personally created and managed.

5. What measurable results have you achieved?

6. What is your strongest advertising platform?

7. Are you comfortable completing a technical interview demonstrating your advertising knowledge?



**FINAL NOTICE**



Please respect our time and yours.



If you do not have real, professional experience managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and YouTube Ads, please do not apply.



We are looking for an experienced advertising specialist who can take responsibility for campaigns, make informed decisions, solve problems, and deliver measurable results.



We value real experience, honesty, professionalism, and proven results.

title: Work From Home Customer Operations Executive (SAP SD) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$250 per week. Full-time.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Australian Eastern Time (AET), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



A leading international apparel and headwear brand is hiring an experienced Customer Operations Executive for its wholesale customer-service team.



You will own wholesale orders from receipt to delivery in SAP SD, keep customers informed, and work with sales, logistics, warehouse and finance so every order is accurate and on time. This is a senior bar role. We want someone who takes ownership, builds their own reports, and can train or back up others in the team.



This role is customer operations only. It is not a supply planning, MRP or forecasting role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Enter, change and manage wholesale customer orders in SAP SD, from order entry through delivery and invoicing (VA01 / VA02, deliveries, billing)

- Process and monitor EDI orders, and fix failed or rejected transactions (including IDocs)

- Track open orders, deliveries, backorders and stock delays

- Build and maintain open-order and delivery-status reports in Excel

- Update wholesale customers on orders and deliveries before issues become problems

- Resolve order discrepancies, short shipments, damaged goods and delivery issues

- Provide invoices, PODs and order acknowledgements

- Process returns and credits in line with company policy

- Handle product, pricing and account enquiries, and troubleshoot B2B platform issues

- Work closely with sales, sourcing, logistics, warehouse and finance

- Support and train other team members on processes and systems

- Help with eCommerce order enquiries when needed



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- 3+ years in B2B order management, wholesale customer operations or wholesale customer service

- Hands-on SAP SD sales order processing: order entry and changes, deliveries, billing and invoicing. Warehouse-only or inventory-only SAP experience is not enough

- Advanced Excel: XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and building open-order and delivery reports

- Experience leading, training or acting as backup for a small team

- Organised, detail-focused and proactive, and able to manage multiple deadlines without being chased

- Able to work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm AET, consistently



STRONGLY PREFERRED



- EDI order management (receiving, monitoring and fixing EDI / IDoc orders)

- Apparel, footwear or headwear industry experience

- Experience in wholesale, retail, FMCG, fashion or distribution

- Experience clearing credit blocks, delivery blocks or billing mismatches in SAP SD



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



- 97% or better order accuracy

- Orders entered within 48 hours of receipt

- Enquiries answered within 24 hours

- Delivery delays communicated before the due date

- Warehouse amendments handled promptly

- Full ownership of issues from start to resolution



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with COE-250 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your application.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm AET (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$250 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A wholesale sales order is blocked and will not create a delivery. Walk us through how you would diagnose and clear it in SAP SD. Cover at least: how you would find the block (which transactions or screens), whether it is a delivery block, credit block or incomplete data issue, the steps and t-codes you would use (for example VA02, VA03, V.23 or similar, VL01N), and how you would confirm the delivery and billing can proceed. If you have fixed a billing mismatch (invoice vs delivery / order qty or price), describe that instead with the same level of t-code detail.



2. It is 10:00am Australian Eastern Time. You have: (a) three EDI orders failing with IDoc errors that sales need fixed today, (b) a key wholesale account chasing a delayed delivery that ships tomorrow, and (c) your manager has just asked for an open-order status report for a call in 90 minutes. How do you prioritise, what do you do first, and how do you communicate upwards so nothing drops?



3. Describe a time you trained, coached or acted as backup for someone on order management or customer operations. What did you teach them, how did you hand over or cover their work, and what changed for the team as a result? Include team size and your role.



Fluent English is required.

title: Cold Caller with Australian Accent: Show New Beauty Salons Their Website
description:
YOU MUST HAVE A NATURAL AUSTRALIAN ACCENT.

If you don't sound Australian on the phone, please don't apply: this job is not for you. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US

Andrea Will Do It is a web design business working with small businesses all over Australia. We find hair salons, barbers, lash and brow studios that have just opened, and we build their website before we call them. Your job is to call them, show them the website we made for them, and sign them up.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call new beauty businesses in Australia from an Australian number (calling app provided)

- Text them the link to their new website and walk them through it

- Explain the offer: the website is free, they only cover the running costs (A$9.99 a month), or A$29.99 a month with ready-made Instagram stories

- Handle objections, book callbacks and send the payment link

- Log the outcome of every call in our sheet

Script, call lists and training are provided.



HOURS

- 10 hours a week to start, during Australian business hours (Melbourne time, Monday to Saturday)

- 2-week paid trial, then ongoing if it works for both of us



PAY: HOURLY + COMMISSION

- US$4.50 per hour, paid weekly

- Commission on top, based on points: Website (A$9.99/month) = 1 point, Website + Stories (A$29.99/month) = 3 points

- From 10 points in a week, every point of the week is paid US$1.50

- Above 20 points in a week, every point is paid US$2

Commission is paid 30 days after the sale, for clients who stay.



REQUIREMENTS

- A natural Australian accent (non-negotiable)

- Fluent, confident spoken English

- Cold calling or phone sales experience preferred

- Quiet room, good headset, stable internet (10 Mbps or more)

- Available during Australian business hours



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "G'DAY", so we know you read this.

2. Attach or link a 60-second voice recording of you reading this opening:

"Hi! Is this Salon 36? Oh, glad I got it right! Because I saw it's a new one, right? Love that! I'm [your name], by the way. I made a website for you, and it's completely free for you. I'd love to know what you think. Can I send it over?"

3. Tell us about your cold calling experience.

title: AI Engineer (Remote — Philippines)
description:
Company: Cornerstone Group (Brisbane, Australia)

Location: 100% remote, based in the Philippines, India or Sri Lanka

Type: Full-time, long-term contractor

Hours: Minimum 4 hours overlap with Brisbane business hours (AEST, UTC+10)

Pay: PHP 50,000–80,000 per month, paid monthly, based on experience

We are an Australian business group looking for a hands-on AI engineer to build our own AI-powered migration and workforce platform from the ground up. You will report directly to the founder, own the product end to end, and see your work used by real clients and employers within weeks, not quarters.

About us

Cornerstone is a Brisbane-based group working across migration, recruitment and workforce, and home construction. Our registered migration practice has helped skilled workers, families and employers for nearly two decades, and we work in both English and Korean.

Where we are going. Our long-term goal is a school and training platform that closes the skills gap between overseas workers and Australian employers. Employers will train candidates directly on the platform, so people arrive work-ready and employers hire with confidence. The software you build is the foundation for that.

We are a small team that cares about the people we help. This is a chance to build something from zero that changes people's lives.

What you'll do

• Design and build a web platform for migration and recruitment work: client records, case tracking by stage, document collection and a client portal

• Build an AI assistant that drafts replies, checks documents and answers questions from client files and official sources, with a person approving everything before it goes out

• Build tools that pre-fill forms and checklists from the client file to cut manual data entry

• Build the training side: courses, assessments, progress tracking and employer-led training modules

• Build candidate and employer matching, so employers can find and follow work-ready candidates

• Choose the tech stack, set up hosting and keep sensitive client data encrypted, logged and secure

• Ship in small stages, test with real users and improve based on what they tell you

• Explain your work in plain English to a non-technical founder

What we're looking for

Must have

• 2+ years building web applications, and at least one working app you built yourself that we can see

• Comfortable with a modern web stack (React or Next.js, Node or Python, a SQL database)

• Hands-on experience adding AI features with LLM APIs such as Claude or OpenAI

• Good at using AI coding tools to build quickly and safely

• Careful with personal data: sign-in, user roles and secure file storage

• Clear written and spoken English, and honest progress updates

• A self-starter who can plan your own work

• Reliable internet, your own computer and a quiet place to work

Nice to have

• Experience building a learning management system or online course platform

• Browser extension or mobile app development

• Experience with CRM, case management or legal-tech products

• Accounting integrations such as Xero

• Experience working with Australian businesses

• Korean language skills

What we offer

• PHP 50,000–80,000 per month, paid on time every month, with reviews as the product grows

• Fully remote, long-term work with a stable Australian business

• Direct access to the founder and real say in what gets built

• Paid AI tools and subscriptions needed for the job

• [Paid leave / local public holidays / 13th-month pay, as applicable]

• A paid trial project before you commit, so both sides can see the fit

How to apply

 
 with the subject line AI Product Engineer — [Your Name] — [Your Country] and include:

1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile

2. Links to 1–2 complete products you built yourself, at least one with AI features (live link, GitHub or a short screen recording)

3. A few lines on one product you built from zero: the problem, your stack, and what happened after launch

4. Your expected monthly rate in PHP and when you can start

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short video call and a small paid test task. Applications without project examples will not be considered.

title: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & COLLECTIONS ASSISTANT | PART-TIME REMOTE
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Rest Easy Pest Control is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable & Collections Assistant to support our daily payment follow-up and collections operations.



You will be responsible for contacting customers regarding declined credit card payments and outstanding balances, sending payment reminders, tracking promised payments, and maintaining accurate account records.



This role is ideal for someone with experience in accounts receivable, collections, billing, or customer service who is comfortable making outbound calls and communicating professionally with customers about outstanding payments.



We are looking for someone organized, proactive, dependable, and capable of managing follow-ups without constant supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Contact customers by phone, text, and
 regarding declined payments and past-due balances.

- Follow up with customers to secure outstanding payments and resolve payment issues.

- Assist customers with updating their payment methods through approved systems.

- Send invoices, account statements, payment reminders, and copies of billing documents.

- Review customer account histories and notes before making contact.

- Document all collection attempts, customer responses, payment commitments, and next steps in PestPac.

- Track promised payment dates and ensure timely follow-ups.

- Maintain organized collections lists and schedules using SharePoint and Excel.

- Use CallTrackingMetrics for calls and text messages and Microsoft Outlook for
 communication.

- Escalate billing disputes, cancellation concerns, and complicated account issues to the team lead.

- Provide daily updates on completed tasks, outstanding accounts, and issues requiring attention.

- Handle customer and payment information with confidentiality and care.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Previous experience in accounts receivable, collections, billing, payment follow-up, or customer service.

- Comfortable making outbound calls to customers regarding outstanding balances and declined payments.

- Professional phone etiquette and the ability to handle payment conversations tactfully.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to maintain accurate records and follow up on promised payments.

- Comfortable working independently and following established procedures.

- Able to learn and navigate different software systems.

- Reliable internet connection, computer, headset, and a quiet work environment.

- Available to work Monday–Friday for 4 hours per day within the 8 AM–5 PM Eastern Time schedule.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience working with U.S.-based customers or businesses.

- Previous experience in a collections or accounts receivable position.

- Familiarity with PestPac, CallTrackingMetrics, or similar CRM and communication platforms.

- Experience using Microsoft Outlook, Excel, SharePoint, or similar tools.

- Background in the pest control, home services, or field service industry.



COMMUNICATION & WORK ENVIRONMENT



- This is a fully remote position.

- Daily communication will take place through Microsoft Teams and Signal.

- Slack may be introduced in the future.

- You must have a stable internet connection, a reliable computer, a working headset, and a quiet workspace.

- You must be comfortable handling customer account information confidentially.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The successful candidate will consistently follow up on outstanding accounts, communicate professionally with customers, secure payments whenever possible, maintain accurate account notes, and ensure no promised payment or follow-up is overlooked.



We value reliability, accountability, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer the following questions when applying:



1. How many years of experience do you have in accounts receivable, collections, or payment follow-up? Briefly describe your relevant experience.



2. Are you comfortable making outbound calls to U.S. customers regarding overdue balances and declined payments? Please share an example of how you've handled this.



3. Are you available to work 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday, within 8 AM–5 PM Eastern Time?

AR COLLECTIONS - [YOUR FULL NAME]



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be prioritized.

title: I'm Looking for a Creative Mind – Content Creation & Video Editing
description:
I'm not just looking for someone who can edit videos. I'm looking for someone who loves content creation, has a creative spark, and wants to become exceptionally good at what they do.



I work on different brands, businesses, and creative projects, and I'm looking for someone who wants to work directly with me to develop and produce great content.



I'm much more interested in your potential than your résumé.



You don't need 5 years of experience, fancy certifications, or a perfect portfolio. What matters to me is your creativity, curiosity, willingness to learn, and ability to think independently.



Who I'm looking for



Ideally, you're someone who:



- Genuinely loves content creation. You naturally pay attention to interesting videos, storytelling techniques, creative formats, and emerging trends.

- Has a creative instinct. You can recognize when something is engaging, interesting, or visually appealing, even if you're still developing your skills.

- Is curious about why content works. You don't just scroll through social media. You wonder why certain videos go viral, why people pay attention, and why some content performs better than others.

- Enjoys video editing. You like experimenting with pacing, music, visuals, transitions, and storytelling to make videos more compelling.

- Thinks independently. You don't want to spend your career simply following instructions. You enjoy contributing your own ideas and finding better ways to do things.

- Is eager to improve. You're open to feedback, willing to experiment, and genuinely excited about becoming better at your craft.



I'm not expecting you to be great at all these things already. I'm looking for someone who has the potential and motivation to develop them.



What we'll work on together



I work with different businesses and brands, each with its own audience, challenges, and creative opportunities.



Depending on the project, you'll help me with:



- Researching audiences, competitors, trends, and successful content.

- Brainstorming creative concepts, content angles, and hooks.

- Editing videos for social media and other platforms.

- Developing visual storytelling styles and experimenting with different formats.

- Creating content for Instagram,
, YouTube, and other channels.

- Studying content performance to understand what worked, what didn't, and why.

- Exploring AI tools and new technologies to make content creation more effective and creative.



I'm particularly interested in understanding the psychology behind successful content — what makes people stop scrolling, become curious, watch something until the end, share it, or remember it.



I want you to develop that understanding with me.



What it's like working with me



You'll work directly with me, not through layers of managers.



I enjoy exploring ideas, understanding how things work, and finding creative solutions. I also believe that creating great content requires more than following trends or copying successful videos.



I'll share what I know about marketing, strategy, audience psychology, and content creation, and I'll expect you to bring your own curiosity, observations, and creative ideas into our work.



We'll experiment, analyze results, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.



Initially, I'll provide plenty of direction and feedback. Over time, I'd love for you to become someone who can independently recognize opportunities, develop strong concepts, and help lead the creative direction of projects.



I'm not looking for someone who just completes tasks. I'm looking for someone who wants to grow into a genuinely great creative professional.



What I can offer



- Direct mentorship and collaboration.

- The opportunity to work across different brands, industries, and creative projects.

- Freedom to experiment and contribute your own ideas.

- Exposure to content strategy, marketing psychology, storytelling, and creative production.

- Opportunities to learn and use modern AI and creative tools.

- Increasing responsibility and creative independence as you develop.

- The potential for a long-term working relationship.



How to apply



I don't need a long, generic cover letter.



I'd much rather get a sense of who you are, what excites you, and how you think.



Please answer these four questions:



1. Show me something you've created.



Share 2–3 examples of videos, social media content, designs, or any other creative projects you've worked on. Personal projects are absolutely fine.



2. Show me how you think.



Share one social media creator, account, or specific video you think is particularly good. Explain what makes the content successful in your opinion.



3. What excites you about content creation?



What do you enjoy most, and what would you love to become exceptionally good at?



4. What skills do you currently have?



Tell me about your experience with video editing, content creation, and the tools you've used.



I'm not looking for perfect answers. I'm looking for personality, originality, genuine curiosity, and creative potential.



I don't expect you to know everything from day one. But I do expect you to be genuinely interested in becoming great at what you do. If you discover something interesting, I want you to share it. If you see an opportunity, I want you to suggest it. And if you think there's a better way to approach something, I want to hear it. I'm looking for someone who doesn't just wait for the next task, but naturally starts thinking about what we could create next.



If you feel like you have that creative spark and just need the right opportunity to develop it, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
About Us

Spectra Acquisition builds and manages cold email pipeline systems for B2B companies. When our campaigns generate interested leads, we need someone sharp on the other end — responding fast, qualifying the prospect, and getting them on a call. That’s you.

The Role

You are the bridge between a warm lead and a booked sales meeting. When someone replies to one of our campaigns showing interest, you respond within 2–5 minutes, qualify them, handle initial objections, and either book them directly onto the client’s calendar or call them to close the appointment. Speed and communication skills are everything in this role.



What you’ll do every day:

Monitor inboxes across multiple client campaigns for positive and interested replies

Respond to warm leads within 2–5 minutes of their reply — speed is critical

Call warm leads directly to qualify and book sales meetings

Handle initial objections and questions over email and phone

Book qualified meetings directly on the client’s calendar (Calendly / 
)

Update CRM with lead status, call notes, and meeting details

Follow up with no-shows and reschedule meetings

Coordinate with the campaign operator on lead quality and targeting feedback

Requirements

Non-negotiable:

Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-sounding accent — you will be calling US-based business owners and executives

Strong written English — your email replies need to sound natural, professional, and human

Experience working with the US market — you understand US business culture, time zones, and communication style

Experience in an SDR, BDR, appointment setter, or inside sales role

Comfortable making outbound calls to warm leads (not cold calling — these people have already shown interest)

Fast response time discipline — if a lead replies at 10:02 AM, you’re calling by 10:05 AM

Reliable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet environment for calls

Available to work during US business hours (EST or CST preferred)



Nice to have:

Experience with Instantly, Smartlead, or similar cold email reply management

Experience using CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Close, GoHighLevel)

Previous work in a lead generation agency or B2B sales environment

Familiarity with booking tools like Calendly



Part-time to start (3–5 hours/day during US business hours), scaling with volume

Performance bonuses tied to meetings booked and show rates

Long-term position with growth potential as we scale

How to Apply

Send a short message explaining:

Your experience in SDR / appointment setting / inside sales roles

Your experience working with US-based clients or companies

Your available hours and timezone

A 2-minute Loom video where you introduce yourself and do a brief mock call — pretend you’re calling a lead who replied saying “I’m interested, tell me more”



If we can’t clearly hear you, understand you, or you have a heavy accent on the Loom, we won’t be able to move forward. This role requires phone-ready English. Please only apply if you’re confident in your spoken English.

title: IT Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In a company with no office, IT is the office. Every laptop, login, tool, and file is how the whole team gets to work, and the whole business runs on it. When it works, nobody notices. When it fails, the whole team stops. Every new hire, tool, and market adds more to look after, and the companies that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns it, and leads the team that makes it work. You’ll keep our systems secure, our tools running, and our people productive, wherever in the world they log in from. You’ll set the standards, guide the IT team, and make sure new teammates are set up in a day, gaps are closed before anyone finds them, and the technology behind the business is something the rest of the team never has to think about.



For a sharp, driven technology leader who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Lead the IT team. Set clear priorities, divide the work, and give your team what it needs to do it well. You’ll coach people, review their work, and build a team that solves problems without waiting to be told.



Own the tech stack. Know every tool, account, and integration we run, who uses it, what it costs, and what depends on it. Choose and set up new tools well, and retire the ones we don’t need.



Keep us secure. Set the standard and make sure it’s followed: strong authentication, access controls, password management, device security, and clear rules for who can reach what. Teach the whole company to spot threats before they click.



Make onboarding and offboarding flawless. Make sure every new hire has working accounts, devices, and access on day one, and that every door closes the moment someone leaves.



Run a help desk that people love. Make sure problems across time zones are solved quickly, track the issues that keep coming back, and fix their causes for good.



Protect our data. Make sure backups are reliable, recovery is tested, and customer and company data is handled in line with the privacy rules in every market we sell in.



Look after our digital foundations. Keep our domains,
, website infrastructure, and tracking healthy, so our store stays up and our
s reach the inbox.



Automate the repetitive work. Build, or have your team build, the scripts, workflows, and integrations that save everyone hours.



Bring in AI safely. Evaluate and set up AI tools for the company, with clear guidance on what data can and can’t go into them.



Control the costs. Audit subscriptions and licenses, catch waste and billing errors, and work with vendors to bring costs down.



Write it down. Make sure how things work and how to fix them is documented, so nothing lives only in one person’s head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, scripting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Leadership people want to follow. You set a clear direction, delegate well, and give honest feedback that helps people improve. You hold a high bar without micromanaging, and you stay close enough to the work to help when it gets hard.



A security mindset. You think about how things could go wrong before they do, and you build habits and safeguards that hold up in practice, not only on paper.



Practical problem solving. You find the real cause fast, fix it cleanly, and learn something from every issue. You’re happy to dig into the unfamiliar.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, make sound calls with incomplete information, and keep people informed while your team fixes it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your instructions leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [4+] years in IT management, systems administration, or a similar role, including [2+] years leading an IT team, ideally supporting remote or distributed teams at a growing company, with results you can show. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact across the business. Every person on the team uses what you and your team build and maintain. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds our technology foundations and the team behind them is the person best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.



This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.



For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.



Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.



Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.



Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.



Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.



Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.



Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.



Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.



What we look for



Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.



Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.



Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.



Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.



Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.



Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.



Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 
/?job=virasst_jazz

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply here: 
/?job=virasst_onl_ph

title: Premiere Pro Wedding Video Editor | $500/Month | Paid Training & Weekly Pay
description:
Build a long-term editing career with EditValue. We are looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors to join our wedding-video team, with paid training, a constant flow of assignments and weekly PayPal payments.



Wedding-editing experience is welcome, but not required. If you already know Premiere, follow instructions carefully and want to improve, we would like to hear from you. Some of our strongest editors started without wedding experience.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You receive synced footage, clear instructions and manageable editing assignments. Our AI prepares the multicam, so your role includes carefully vetting the ceremony and editing assigned sequences. A team leader gives feedback and helps you become faster and more consistent.



Real work and continued training go hand in hand. You learn the wedding workflow one sequence at a time, progressing toward reels and complete wedding highlights.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term position with a steady flow of wedding-video work

- Around US$500 per month, with weekly PayPal payments for approved work

- Paid training, tutorials and individual guidance

- A clear path to more advanced editing and responsibility



WHAT YOU NEED

- Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and access to it for the assessment

- A suitable Windows PC. This workflow is not Mac-based. We supply the matching Premiere version for training and work.

- An active PayPal account that can receive payments

- Conversational spoken English

- Reliable delivery, attention to detail and responsive communication

- Availability Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 14:00 Israel time during initial training (currently 3 PM to 8 PM in the Philippines)



After approximately one month, editors who understand the workflow and can work independently may move to flexible editing hours. This depends on your progress. You must still complete assigned projects and meet deadlines.



THE PAID SKILLS TEST

Shortlisted applicants complete a US$2 paid editing assessment before training. It uses old footage from a real wedding completed and delivered several years ago, not a current client delivery.



The tasks are an already-synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception edit. For the reception portion, use only reception and venue shots, such as the setup, decorations, tables, food, and guests during the reception. Do not use dancing, party, or ceremony footage, even if it appears in the supplied reception timeline. You submit only full-timeline screenshots and low-quality previews uploaded to 
. No Premiere project file is requested. Instructions and all test materials are supplied.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with CEREMONY and include:

1. A short, approximately 30-second spoken English introduction. This is required. A Vocaroo link is fine; no video is necessary.

2. Confirmation that you use a Windows PC and can edit in Adobe Premiere Pro.

3. Confirmation that your PayPal account is active and can RECEIVE payments.

4. Confirmation that you can reliably attend the initial training hours and complete assignments. If you have another job, please make sure the schedule is realistic before applying.

5. If you have wedding-editing experience, one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional.



We value reliability, careful work and a willingness to learn. We look forward to meeting our next long-term team member.

title: Full-Time Senior Bookkeeper | AU
description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



1. You do not have at least 5 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. General accounting experience outside Australia does not count towards this requirement.



2. You have never independently managed Australian payroll, including employee setup, weekly payroll processing, PAYG withholding and superannuation.



3. You are not confident with Australian GST, BAS and other relevant taxation requirements.



4. You do not have strong, hands-on experience using Xero, including bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable.



5. You have no practical experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.



6. You require constant supervision, regular reminders or step-by-step instructions to manage your daily responsibilities.



7. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where accuracy, urgency and accountability are essential.



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

title: Experienced Executive Assistant to the Director and Founder

Full-time, 40 hours a week. Remote, independent contractor.

title: Event Coordination VA for Fast-Growing Events Company in Australia
description:

Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring for an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events. Each event runs across multiple days with 20–25+ vendors, a full marketing campaign, and a long list of suppliers to book and confirm. They run on a repeating monthly cycle, which means there is always one event in delivery and another in build.



We need a remote Event Operations Coordinator to own the moving parts from the moment an event is confirmed through to post-event close-out.



This is a coordination and execution role, not a creative or strategy role. You won't be d
 the event theme, the commercial model or which vendors get accepted. You will be the person who makes sure everything that was d
 actually happens, on time.



What you'll be doing

- Running the master event tracker — setting each event up, calculating task due dates from the event date, assigning tasks, checking daily, chasing what's overdue

- Sending a structured end-of-day report so management can see an event's status without opening the tracker

- Vendor administration across 20–25+ vendors per event: contracts, signatures, food safety certificates, public liability insurance, stall size, power requirements, commission arrangements, contact and social media records

- Vendor communication: welcome packs, marketing requirements, bump-in details, final briefings, one-week-out reminders, and answering routine questions from approved information

- Tracking vendor marketing compliance — required posts, countdown banners, event shares — and chasing before every posting deadline

- Coordinating content creators and influencers: briefs, shoot dates, attendance, deliverables, chasing content and saving links

- Running influencer night logistics, voucher printing and distribution, and food send-outs

-
 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

- Updating the event website in WordPress/Elementor each cycle — dates, venue, map, parking, FAQs, vendor lineup, competition, images — and testing every link on desktop and mobile

-
 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

- Local outreach: community businesses, universities and TAFEs, flyer and banner distribution, local media and council invitations

- QR code and lead capture campaigns: landing page, signage, onsite testing, tagging leads by event

- Supplier and infrastructure bookings: power, cool rooms, equipment hire, barriers and lighting, cleaning and waste, security — booking, confirming, and following up delivery and collection

- Building the multi-day event run sheet and confirming every arrival time, shift and delivery against it

- Vendor commissions, reconciliation, and the final post-event report



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating events, projects or operations remotely. Events experience is a strong bonus, but disciplined project coordination in any industry is highly regarded

- You are relentless about following up. A large part of this role is chasing people who haven't replied — politely, repeatedly, without being asked to

- Strongly detail-oriented, with a habit of recording proof rather than just marking things done

- Hands-on with WordPress and Elementor, or able to demonstrate you can learn it quickly — you'll be editing event pages yourself, not raising tickets

- Confident with task management tools, spreadsheets,
 marketing platforms and social scheduling

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main point of contact for dozens of vendors and suppliers

- Good judgement about what you handle yourself versus what you escalate

- Able to hold a lot of concurrent deadlines across two overlapping event cycles without dropping any



What success looks like:

- You've run at least one full event cycle end to end, from confirmation to close-out

- The tracker is current every working day and nothing sits overdue without being flagged

- Vendor compliance documents are collected ahead of deadline rather than chased in the final week

- The end-of-day report is running consistently and management is relying on it

- A complete post-event report has been delivered covering attendance, vendor sales, marketing performance and key learnings
