title: AI Video Editor for Meta Ads – Wellness DTC Brand
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling at-home wellness devices. Meta 
 and Instagram) is our main growth channel, and video ads are a big part of it. Most of our customers are 55+, so every ad has to be clear, credible and easy to follow.



The role



We're looking for an AI video editor who specializes in performance ads for Meta. Not an everyday video editor, and not someone who only cuts existing footage. You combine strong editing craft with AI video and image tools to create complete ads, from generated scenes and b-roll to the final cut.



Here's how we work: we handle the creative strategy and send you a script, a brief and a reference ad. You look at the reference, understand the format and why it works, and know exactly how to recreate it for our product, in our style. No step-by-step instructions needed. You bring the editing craft, a sharp eye for detail and real care for quality.



This is a long-term collaboration. We want someone who wants to grow with our brand, not someone who delivers a file and disappears.



What you'll do



• Turn a script, a brief and a reference ad into a finished video ad: recreate the structure, pacing and visual style of the reference, adapted to our product and our brand.

• Generate scenes, b-roll, product shots and UGC-style footage with AI video and image tools (such as Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen or ElevenLabs) and combine them with existing footage.

• Work across many ad formats: UGC-style and testimonials, talking head, voiceover with b-roll, problem/solution, us vs. them, listicles, product demos, podcast or interview style, advertorial style and more.

• Make several hook versions per ad, so we can test which opening works best.

• Add captions, text overlays, music and sound that fit the brief and the brand.

• Check every video before you deliver it: spelling, numbers, ratings, claims and product shots must be correct and match the voiceover. AI output gets an extra check for distorted hands or faces, garbled text and product details that don't match the real product.

• Share what you see working for other brands on Meta.

• Turn around revisions quickly and keep clear communication with our team.



Must haves



• Hands-on experience making ads with AI video and image tools. You can show ads where a large part of the footage was AI-generated and still looks real and credible. You know which tool to use for which shot and how to keep characters and products consistent across scenes.

• You can recreate a reference in our style. We give you a script, a brief and a reference, and you deliver an ad that follows the same concept but looks and feels like our brand: our product, our colors and fonts, and a tone that works for a 55+ audience.

• Proven experience with Meta video ads for DTC e-commerce brands. You know what makes a direct-response ad work: a strong hook, a clear product in the first seconds, proof and a clear call to action.

• A track record you can show. A portfolio with ads you made for DTC brands, ideally with some context on how they performed.

• A real eye for detail. You catch a typo, a wrong number, text that doesn't match the voiceover or an AI glitch before we do. Nothing leaves your desk unchecked.

• In it for the long term. You want to get to know our brand, our products and our customers, and grow with us.

• Reliable. You meet deadlines, communicate clearly in English and handle feedback well.



Nice to have



• Experience with health, wellness or beauty products.

• Experience making ads for an older audience (55+).

• Experience with AI voiceovers and AI avatars.

• Motion graphics skills for simple animated text, product callouts and infographics.



Our hiring process



1. Review: we read every application carefully.

2. Trial task: shortlisted candidates receive a first paid task, based on a brief from our creative team.

3. Next steps: if the trial goes well, we continue with regular briefs and build a long-term collaboration from there.



How to apply



Please apply through our application form. It takes about 10 minutes:

title: Social Media Manager & Video Editor Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for a creative, proactive, and detail-oriented Social Media Manager & Video Editor Virtual Assistant to support a U.S.-based teenage content creator who advocates for skin health, melanoma awareness, and skin cancer prevention.



The role involves researching social media trends, developing engaging content ideas, preparing scripts and filming instructions, editing short-form videos, and helping manage content for Instagram and TikTok. The content creator also collaborates with nonprofit organizations, so the VA will help organize content and ensure deadlines are met.



We are looking for someone who understands current social media trends, can create engaging content for a younger audience, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



SHIFT:

Flexible Philippine daytime hours, preferably 2 hours per day spread throughout the workweek. Must be available early in the week and before the weekend to prepare content for filming. No fixed U.S. business-hour shift is required.



Duties and Responsibilities



1. Social Media Content Planning

- Research current trends, content ideas, and video formats for Instagram and TikTok.

- Develop engaging content ideas related to skincare, hair, nails, sun protection, and lifestyle topics.

- Plan and organize content for nonprofit collaborations and regular social media posts.

- Maintain a content calendar and track posting deadlines.



2. Content Creation & Scriptwriting

- Create content briefs, video concepts, hooks, scripts, and captions.

- Prepare clear filming instructions, including shot lists, camera angles, and B-roll suggestions.

- Ensure filming briefs are ready before the weekend.

- Adjust content based on feedback and maintain the creator's natural voice.



3. Video Editing

- Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

- Add subtitles, on-screen text, music, transitions, and other engaging elements.

- Create thumbnails and video cover images.

- Review and revise videos based on feedback.

- Organize video files, drafts, and completed content.



4. Social Media Support

- Repurpose Instagram videos for TikTok.

- Prepare captions and publish approved TikTok content.

- Assist with scheduling content using Metricool or similar tools.

- Coordinate content approvals and provide regular progress updates.



Note: The content creator will continue managing her own Instagram posting and audience engagement.



Qualifications

- Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and short-form video editing.

- Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok trends, and audience engagement.

- Experience using video editing tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Ability to create engaging hooks, scripts, captions, and content ideas.

- Familiarity with Canva and social media scheduling tools.

- Experience using Metricool is an advantage.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Creative, organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and follow content guidelines.

- Experience creating beauty, skincare, wellness, or lifestyle content is a plus.

- Must be comfortable creating age-appropriate content for a teenage audience.



Key Expectations

- Be proactive in researching trends and suggesting fresh content ideas.

- Deliver content briefs before scheduled filming days.

- Produce high-quality videos and complete revisions on time.

- Maintain clear communication and keep content organized.

- Ensure skincare and health-related content is responsible, accurate, and appropriate for a teenage advocate.

title: # 🎬 HIRING: CREATIVE STREET INTERVIEW / SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
🎬 HIRING: CREATIVE STREET INTERVIEW / SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR



Looking for a LONG-TERM Video Editor — QUALITY OVER QUANTITY!




==



I'm looking for a creative, reliable, and detail-oriented video editor who knows how to turn raw street interviews into engaging, high-quality Instagram Reels, TikToks,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



I don't want someone who just cuts clips. I want someone who understands storytelling, strong hooks, audience retention, and how to make content BETTER!



### 🎯 VIDEO EDITING REQUIREMENTS



- Video length: **45 seconds to 1 minute 20 seconds**

- Vertical format: 9:16 (1080 × 1920)

- Strong attention-grabbing hook within the first 1–3 seconds

- Clean, smooth cuts with no unnecessary pauses or dead space

- Animated captions with highlighted keywords

- Match caption fonts and styles from provided references

- Strategic zoom-ins, punch-ins, and camera reframing

- Creative B-roll, relevant photos, and tasteful sound effects

- Basic to advanced color correction for raw footage

- Clear dialogue and professional audio cleanup

- Background music when appropriate (low volume)

- Natural storytelling that keeps viewers watching

- Ability to identify the strongest moments without being told everything

- Ability to create **Part 1 and Part 2** from one interview when the content supports it



### 🔥 WHAT I'M REALLY LOOKING FOR



I want an editor who THINKS!



Someone who can watch an interview, recognize the strongest moments, create a powerful opening, and turn ordinary footage into engaging content.



Don't just edit the footage. Improve it!



### 🎥 REQUIRED FREE SKILL TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive raw footage to create one **45-second sample edit**.



Your sample MUST demonstrate:



1. A strong 1–3 second opening hook.

2. Clean cuts and engaging pacing.

3. Professional animated captions.

4. At least one relevant B-roll clip.

5. At least one relevant photo or picture incorporated naturally.

6. Creative zooms, transitions, and sound effects where appropriate.

7. Clean audio and color correction.

8. A strong ending that encourages viewers to engage or watch Part 2.



**The free test is strictly for evaluating your skills and will not be published or used commercially without a separate agreement.**



### 📩 HOW TO APPLY



Please send ALL of the following:



1. Portfolio: Links to 3 of your BEST short-form videos, preferably interviews or podcasts.

2.Pricing: Your price per completed video (45–80 seconds) in USD.

3. Package Pricing: Your rate for 10 and 20 videos.

4. Turnaround: How many hours do you need to complete one video?

5. Software: What editing software do you use?

6. Experience: Have you edited street interviews, podcasts, or talking-head videos?

7. Creative Process: Explain how you would turn raw interview footage into an engaging 45-second Reel.

title: Hiring: SEO & Local Search Growth Specialist
description:
Remote | Part-Time or Ongoing Contract | Hourly or Monthly Retainer



Our website 
 this brand is very new. 



We are looking for an experienced **SEO & Local Search Growth Specialist** to help grow the search visibility, domain authority, and organic traffic of our business websites.



Our websites are relatively new, and we're looking for someone who can build a strong SEO foundation, develop a long-term growth strategy, and consistently execute that strategy.



You will work alongside our existing SEO and marketing team, with a primary focus on off-page SEO, backlink acquisition, local search optimization, business citations, and content outreach.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and results-driven—not someone who simply builds backlinks without a clear strategy.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Backlink Building & Website Authority

- Research and acquire high-quality, relevant backlinks from trustworthy websites.

- Identify industry-specific backlink opportunities.

- Conduct outreach to relevant blogs, publications, directories, and business websites.

- Secure guest-posting opportunities and editorial placements.

- Identify competitor backlinks and opportunities to earn similar or better placements.

- Monitor backlink quality, referring domains, and authority metrics.

- Avoid link farms, private blog networks (PBNs), spammy directories, and other manipulative link-building practices.

- Review potentially harmful backlinks and recommend appropriate action when necessary.



 2. Google Business Profile & Local SEO

- Set up, verify, optimize, and manage Google Business Profiles.

- Set up and maintain Bing Places for Business profiles.

- Optimize business listings for Google Maps, Bing Maps, and local search results.

- Develop strategies to improve visibility in Google's Local Pack (Map Pack).

- Research local competitors and evaluate their rankings.

- Optimize business categories, services, descriptions, photos, and other profile information.

- Monitor and report local keyword rankings.

- Recommend strategies for earning authentic customer reviews.

- Maintain consistent business information across all online listings.



3. Local Citation Building & Directory Management

- Research and create listings on reputable local and industry-specific directories.

- Build citations across relevant business listing platforms.

- Audit existing citations for incorrect or inconsistent information.

- Correct duplicate, outdated, or incomplete listings.

- Prioritize citation sources based on relevance, trustworthiness, and local SEO value.

- Maintain a spreadsheet tracking citation URLs, statuses, login information, and completion dates.



4. Guest Posting, Blog Outreach & Content Placement

- Identify websites accepting relevant guest contributions.

- Research industry publications and editorial opportunities.

- Coordinate content writing with our existing team.

- Pitch blog topics and coordinate content placement.

- Identify opportunities to earn relevant editorial mentions and backlinks.

- Ensure content placements support our services, target keywords, and overall SEO strategy.

- Track published articles, placement URLs, backlinks, and results.



### 5. SEO Strategy & Website Growth Planning

Because our websites are relatively new, we want someone who can create a structured growth plan.



Responsibilities include:

- Conduct an initial SEO audit and competitive analysis.

- Evaluate the website's current search visibility and authority.

- Identify keyword opportunities and develop a priority ranking strategy.

- Review website pages and recommend on-page SEO improvements.

- Identify content gaps and recommend new service pages and blog topics.

- Create a 30-, 60-, and 90-day SEO action plan.

- Develop a longer-term 6- to 12-month SEO growth roadmap.

- Coordinate off-page efforts with our existing SEO team.

- Continuously adjust strategies based on rankings, traffic, and results.



 6. Reporting, Slack Communication & Project Management

We want consistent communication and clear visibility into progress.



You will be expected to:

- Work with our team using **Slack** for communication and updates.

- Post weekly progress reports highlighting completed work.

- Maintain a shared SEO task tracker or project spreadsheet.

- Track backlinks, citation submissions, guest posts, and outreach activity.

- Provide monthly SEO performance reports.

- Monitor Google Search Console, Google Analytics, keyword rankings, and local search visibility.

- Participate in recurring strategy and progress check-ins.

- Identify obstacles and proactively recommend next steps.

- Maintain a living SEO plan outlining current priorities, completed tasks, and upcoming initiatives.



 Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience with SEO, backlink acquisition, and local search optimization.

- Experience managing Google Business Profiles and Bing Places.

- Strong understanding of Google Maps rankings and Local Pack visibility.

- Proven experience with guest-post outreach and citation building.

- Knowledge of ethical, sustainable SEO practices.

- Familiarity with Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, BrightLocal, Whitespark, or similar tools.

- Experience using Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

- Strong written English and professional communication skills.

- Ability to develop and execute an SEO strategy independently.

- Comfortable collaborating with an existing team through Slack.

- Organized and able to document work and report measurable results.



 Preferred Experience

- SEO for local service-based businesses.

- Experience with companies operating in multiple service areas.

- Experience with relatively new websites that have limited backlinks and authority.

- Knowledge of Webflow SEO.

- Experience with event services, entertainment, production companies, or other competitive local industries.



## What Success Looks Like



We are looking for sustainable, measurable improvements, including:



- Growth in high-quality, relevant referring domains.

- Improved local search rankings and Map Pack visibility.

- Increased Google Business Profile visibility and customer interactions.

- More accurate and complete local citations.

- Growth in organic search impressions, clicks, and qualified leads.

- Improved rankings for our priority service keywords.

- Consistent execution of a documented SEO growth plan.

- Transparent reporting and communication with our existing team.



We understand SEO takes time. We value quality, consistency, and long-term results over shortcuts or unrealistic ranking guarantees.

title: Detail-oriented Bookkeeper – Full-Time | Remote | AU
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

title: Media Buyer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.



This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.



For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll d
 the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.



Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.



Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.



Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.



Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.



Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.



Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.



Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.



Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Campaigns go live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your decisions move the numbers.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.

A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the buyer who runs our growth channel is the buyer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

- Strong working knowledge of Australian tax and ATO requirements, including GST, PAYG, Division 7A, trust distributions and resolutions, CGT and company tax

- Advanced Xero skills; experience with Australian tax software and the ATO Online Services for Agents portal

- High-quality, well-organised workpapers with clear notes and references

- Strong written and spoken English

NICE TO HAVE

- Class Super or other SMSF software experience

- Xero experience

- Exposure to restructures, tax planning or management reporting



WORK SETUP

- Full-time remote, Monday to Friday

- Hours aligned with Melbourne business hours

- Own reliable laptop, stable high-speed internet, backup power/internet, and a quiet private workspace

- Strict confidentiality and data security required



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive monthly rate for senior-level experience

- Immediate start

- Long-term opportunity with a growing Australian practice

- Exposure to a wide range of Australian clients and entity types



HOW TO APPLY

1. Your Australian accounting experience: years of experience, entity types handled, and whether you completed full jobs end-to-end
